entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] {f : E → ℝ}, ConvexOpt.IsConvex f → ∀ {G : ℝ}, 0 ≤ G → ∀ (c : ℝ), 0 < c → ∀ (g : ℕ → E), (∀ (i : ℕ), ‖g i‖ ≤ G) → ∀ (w₀ z : E) {t : ℕ}, 0 < t → have w := ConvexOpt.approxGDIterate (c / √↑t) w₀ g; 1 / ↑t * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range t, f (w i) ≤ f z + ‖w₀ - z‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c * √↑t) + c * G ^ 2 / (2 * √↑t) + 1 / ↑t * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range t, ConvexOpt.approxNoiseTerm f g w z i

entries.name: ConvexOpt.gd_convex_convergence
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] {f : E → ℝ} {β : ℝ}, 0 < β → ConvexOpt.BetaSmooth f β → ConvexOpt.IsConvex f → ∀ (w₀ z : E) {t : ℕ}, 0 < t → f (ConvexOpt.gdIterate f (fun x => β⁻¹) w₀ t) - f z ≤ β / (2 * ↑t) * (‖w₀ - z‖ ^ 2 - ‖ConvexOpt.gdIterate f (fun x => β⁻¹) w₀ t - z‖ ^ 2)

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M Mdagger : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (u : ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → Lasso.NonzeroCoordinates β → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.posDlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β (u ε)) → ∀ (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsPositiveLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → ∀ (w : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ (μ : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → Lasso.isParametricLCP M r lambda μ (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso μ) (w μ)) → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnNonnegativeCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → Lasso.LocallyLipschitzOnCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → Lasso.ScaledPrimalPathLocallyAffineAtDifferentiable x_lasso → ∃ C > 0, Lasso.pseudoInverseSeminorm Mdagger r ≤ C ∧ ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∀ δ > 0, ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), ∀ᵐ (τ : ℝ), τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 s → deriv (fun σ => 1 / (1 + σ * lambda) * (inner ℝ (w σ) (Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) σ - Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso σ) + Lasso.pathDelta M (fun ρ => Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) ρ) (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) σ)) τ - inner ℝ (deriv (fun σ => (1 / (1 + σ * lambda)) • w σ) τ) (Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) τ - Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso τ) ≤ C * (1 / Real.log (1 / ε) * (1 + deriv (Lasso.positiveZUpward x_lasso) τ) + deriv (Lasso.positiveZDownward x_lasso) τ) + δ

entries.name: Lasso.energy_complementarity_bound_of_monotone
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M Mdagger : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (u : ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → Lasso.NonzeroCoordinates β → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.posDlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β (u ε)) → ∀ (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsPositiveLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → ∀ (w : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ParametricLCPDualRegular M Mdagger r lambda w → (∀ (μ : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → Lasso.isParametricLCP M r lambda μ (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso μ) (w μ)) → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnNonnegativeCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → Lasso.LocallyLipschitzOnCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → (∀ (ν ν' : ℝ), 0 ≤ ν → ν ≤ ν' → ∀ (i : ι), ν * (x_lasso ν).ofLp i ≤ ν' * (x_lasso ν').ofLp i) → ∃ C > 0, Lasso.pseudoInverseSeminorm Mdagger r ≤ C ∧ ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∀ δ > 0, ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), ∀ᵐ (τ : ℝ), τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 s → deriv (fun σ => 1 / (1 + σ * lambda) * (inner ℝ (w σ) (Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) σ - Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso σ) + Lasso.pathDelta M (fun ρ => Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) ρ) (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) σ)) τ - inner ℝ (deriv (fun σ => (1 / (1 + σ * lambda)) • w σ) τ) (Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) τ - Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso τ) ≤ C * (1 / Real.log (1 / ε) * (1 + deriv (Lasso.positiveZUpward x_lasso) τ) + deriv (Lasso.positiveZDownward x_lasso) τ) + δ

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ), Lasso.IsPositiveSemidefinite M → ∀ (r y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.matVec M y = r → ∀ (lambda : ℝ), 0 ≤ lambda → ∀ (z w : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ (μ : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → Lasso.isParametricLCP M r lambda μ (z μ) (w μ)) → ∀ (μ h : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → 0 < h → ∃ ξ, h⁻¹ • (Lasso.scaledDualPath lambda w (μ + h) - Lasso.scaledDualPath lambda w μ) = Lasso.matVec M ξ ∧ inner ℝ ξ (Lasso.matVec M ξ) ≤ inner ℝ y (Lasso.matVec M y)

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ), M.IsSymm → ∀ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), gradient (fun u' => Lasso.posDlnObjective M r lambda u') u = Lasso.euclideanOf fun i => 2 * u.ofLp i * ((Lasso.matVec M (Lasso.coordinateSquare u)).ofLp i - r.ofLp i + lambda)

entries.name: Lasso.lasso_connection_approx
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β γ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (w : ℝ → ℝ → WithLp 2 (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → (∀ (i : ι), β.ofLp i ≠ γ.ofLp i ∧ β.ofLp i ≠ -γ.ofLp i) → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.dlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β γ (w ε)) → ∀ (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnPositiveCompacts x_lasso → Lasso.LocallyLipschitzOnCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath fun μ => Lasso.signedCanonicalSplit (x_lasso μ)) → (Lasso.ScaledPrimalPathLocallyAffineAtDifferentiable fun μ => Lasso.signedCanonicalSplit (x_lasso μ)) → ∃ C > 0, ∀ s > 0, ∀ δ > 0, ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), Lasso.lassoObjective M r lambda s (Lasso.averageTrajectory (w ε) (Lasso.timeFromRescaled ε s)) ≤ Lasso.lassoMin M r lambda s + C * Lasso.suboptimalityGap lambda s (Lasso.signedZDownward x_lasso s) + δ

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β γ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ → WithLp 2 (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → (∀ (i : ι), β.ofLp i ≠ γ.ofLp i ∧ β.ofLp i ≠ -γ.ofLp i) → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.dlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β γ (w ε)) → ∀ (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → (∀ (i : ι), MonotoneOn (fun μ => μ * (x_lasso μ).ofLp i) (Set.Ioi 0) ∨ AntitoneOn (fun μ => μ * (x_lasso μ).ofLp i) (Set.Ioi 0)) → Filter.Tendsto (fun ε => Lasso.lassoObjective M r lambda s (Lasso.averageTrajectory (w ε) (Lasso.timeFromRescaled ε s))) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (Lasso.lassoMin M r lambda s))

entries.name: Lasso.pos_delta_bound_3

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∀ (z zε w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.Nonnegative (s⁻¹ • z) → Lasso.Nonnegative (s⁻¹ • zε) → Lasso.matVec M (s⁻¹ • z) + Lasso.lcpQ r lambda s = s⁻¹ • w → M.IsSymm → Lasso.positiveLassoObjective M r lambda s (s⁻¹ • zε) - Lasso.positiveLassoObjective M r lambda s (s⁻¹ • z) = s⁻¹ ^ 2 * (inner ℝ w (zε - z) + 1 / 2 * inner ℝ (zε - z) (Lasso.matVec M (zε - z)))

entries.name: Lasso.positive_energy_integrated_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M Mdagger : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (u : ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → Lasso.NonzeroCoordinates β → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.posDlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β (u ε)) → ∀ (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsPositiveLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → ∀ (w : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ParametricLCPDualRegular M Mdagger r lambda w → (∀ (μ : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → Lasso.isParametricLCP M r lambda μ (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso μ) (w μ)) → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnNonnegativeCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → Lasso.LocallyLipschitzOnCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → Lasso.ScaledPrimalPathLocallyAffineAtDifferentiable x_lasso → ∃ C > 0, ∀ s > 0, ∀ δ > 0, ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), inner ℝ (w s) (Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) s - Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso s) + Lasso.pathDelta M (fun ρ => Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) ρ) (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) s ≤ s ^ 2 * (C * Lasso.suboptimalityGap lambda s (Lasso.positiveZDownward x_lasso s) + δ)

entries.name: Lasso.positive_energy_integrated_bound_of_monotone
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M Mdagger : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (u : ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → Lasso.NonzeroCoordinates β → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.posDlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β (u ε)) → ∀ (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsPositiveLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → ∀ (w : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ParametricLCPDualRegular M Mdagger r lambda w → (∀ (μ : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → Lasso.isParametricLCP M r lambda μ (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso μ) (w μ)) → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnNonnegativeCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → Lasso.LocallyLipschitzOnCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → (∀ (ν ν' : ℝ), 0 ≤ ν → ν ≤ ν' → ∀ (i : ι), ν * (x_lasso ν).ofLp i ≤ ν' * (x_lasso ν').ofLp i) → ∃ C > 0, ∀ s > 0, ∀ δ > 0, ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), inner ℝ (w s) (Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) s - Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso s) + Lasso.pathDelta M (fun ρ => Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) ρ) (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) s ≤ s ^ 2 * (C * Lasso.suboptimalityGap lambda s (Lasso.positiveZDownward x_lasso s) + δ)

entries.name: Lasso.positive_integrated_mirror_equation
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda ε : ℝ) (β : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (u : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.posDlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β u → (∀ (t : ℝ) (i : ι), (Lasso.posEffectiveParameter u t).ofLp i ≠ 0) → M.IsSymm → ∀ (s : ℝ), Real.log (1 / ε) ≠ 0 → Lasso.posRescaledMirrorVariable ε u s = Lasso.posRescaledMirrorVariable ε u 0 - s • r + Lasso.matVec M (Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε u s) + (s * lambda) • Lasso.ones

entries.name: Lasso.positive_path_delta_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → Lasso.NonzeroCoordinates β → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.posDlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β (u ε)) → ∀ (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsPositiveLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → ∀ (Mdagger : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (w : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ParametricLCPDualRegular M Mdagger r lambda w → (∀ (μ : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → Lasso.isParametricLCP M r lambda μ (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso μ) (w μ)) → Lasso.ScaledPrimalPathLocallyAffineAtDifferentiable x_lasso → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnNonnegativeCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → Lasso.LocallyLipschitzOnCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → ∃ C > 0, ∀ δ > 0, ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), Lasso.pathDelta M (fun τ => Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) τ) (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) s ≤ C * (Lasso.positiveZDownward x_lasso s + δ)

entries.name: Lasso.positive_path_delta_bound_full
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → Lasso.NonzeroCoordinates β → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.posDlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β (u ε)) → ∀ (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsPositiveLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → ∀ (Mdagger : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (w : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ParametricLCPDualRegular M Mdagger r lambda w → (∀ (μ : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → Lasso.isParametricLCP M r lambda μ (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso μ) (w μ)) → Lasso.ScaledPrimalPathLocallyAffineAtDifferentiable x_lasso → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnNonnegativeCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → Lasso.LocallyLipschitzOnCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → ∃ C > 0, ∀ δ > 0, ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), Lasso.pathDelta M (fun τ => Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) τ) (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) s ≤ C * (Lasso.deltaFullError ε s (Lasso.positiveZUpward x_lasso s) (Lasso.positiveZDownward x_lasso s) + δ)

entries.name: Lasso.positive_path_energy_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M Mdagger : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (u : ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → Lasso.NonzeroCoordinates β → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.posDlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β (u ε)) → ∀ (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsPositiveLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → ∀ (w : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ParametricLCPDualRegular M Mdagger r lambda w → (∀ (μ : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → Lasso.isParametricLCP M r lambda μ (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso μ) (w μ)) → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnNonnegativeCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → Lasso.LocallyLipschitzOnCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → Lasso.ScaledPrimalPathLocallyAffineAtDifferentiable x_lasso → ∃ C > 0, ∀ s > 0, ∀ δ > 0, ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), Lasso.positiveLassoObjective M r lambda s (Lasso.posAverageTrajectory (u ε) (Lasso.posTimeFromRescaled ε s)) ≤ Lasso.posLassoMin M r lambda s + C * Lasso.suboptimalityGap lambda s (Lasso.positiveZDownward x_lasso s) + δ

entries.name: Lasso.positive_path_energy_bound_of_monotone
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M Mdagger : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (u : ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → Lasso.NonzeroCoordinates β → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.posDlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β (u ε)) → ∀ (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsPositiveLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → ∀ (w : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ParametricLCPDualRegular M Mdagger r lambda w → (∀ (μ : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → Lasso.isParametricLCP M r lambda μ (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso μ) (w μ)) → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnNonnegativeCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → Lasso.LocallyLipschitzOnCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → (∀ (ν ν' : ℝ), 0 ≤ ν → ν ≤ ν' → ∀ (i : ι), ν * (x_lasso ν).ofLp i ≤ ν' * (x_lasso ν').ofLp i) → ∃ C > 0, ∀ s > 0, ∀ δ > 0, ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), Lasso.positiveLassoObjective M r lambda s (Lasso.posAverageTrajectory (u ε) (Lasso.posTimeFromRescaled ε s)) ≤ Lasso.posLassoMin M r lambda s + C * Lasso.suboptimalityGap lambda s (Lasso.positiveZDownward x_lasso s) + δ

entries.name: Lasso.psd_lcp_unique_dual

entries.name: Lasso.psd_matrix_norm_sq_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ), Lasso.IsPositiveSemidefinite M → ∃ C, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), ‖Lasso.matVec M v‖ * ‖Lasso.matVec M v‖ ≤ C * inner ℝ v (Lasso.matVec M v)

entries.name: Lasso.psd_zero_quadratic_imp_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ), Lasso.IsPositiveSemidefinite M → ∀ (d : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), inner ℝ d (Lasso.matVec M d) = 0 → Lasso.matVec M d = 0

entries.name: Lasso.pseudoInverse_inner_prop
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M Mdagger : Matrix ι ι ℝ), M.IsSymm → (∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.matVec M (Lasso.matVec Mdagger (Lasso.matVec M v)) = Lasso.matVec M v) → ∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), inner ℝ (Lasso.matVec M v) (Lasso.matVec Mdagger (Lasso.matVec M v)) = inner ℝ v (Lasso.matVec M v)

entries.name: Lasso.quadraticLoss
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → Matrix ι ι ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ

entries.name: Lasso.quadraticLoss_complete_square
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), M.IsSymm → Lasso.matVec M y = r → inner ℝ (x - y) (Lasso.matVec M (x - y)) = 2 * Lasso.quadraticLoss M r x + inner ℝ y (Lasso.matVec M y)

entries.name: Lasso.quadraticLoss_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (c : ℝ), Lasso.quadraticLoss M r (c • x) = 1 / 2 * c ^ 2 * inner ℝ x (Lasso.matVec M x) - c * inner ℝ r x

entries.name: Lasso.quadraticLoss_splitDifference_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (ι ⊕ ι)), Lasso.quadraticLoss M r (Lasso.splitDifference y) = Lasso.quadraticLoss (Lasso.augmentedMatrix M) (Lasso.augmentedVector r) y

entries.name: Lasso.quadratic_expansion
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (q x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), M.IsSymm → 1 / 2 * inner ℝ y (Lasso.matVec M y) + inner ℝ q y - (1 / 2 * inner ℝ x (Lasso.matVec M x) + inner ℝ q x) = 1 / 2 * inner ℝ (y - x) (Lasso.matVec M (y - x)) + inner ℝ (Lasso.matVec M x + q) (y - x)

entries.name: Lasso.quadratic_expansion_eval
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (q x d : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (t : ℝ), M.IsSymm → 1 / 2 * inner ℝ (x + t • d) (Lasso.matVec M (x + t • d)) + inner ℝ q (x + t • d) - (1 / 2 * inner ℝ x (Lasso.matVec M x) + inner ℝ q x) = t ^ 2 * (1 / 2 * inner ℝ d (Lasso.matVec M d)) + t * inner ℝ (Lasso.matVec M x + q) d

entries.name: Lasso.rescaledTime_timeFromRescaled

entries.name: Lasso.scaledDualPath_smul_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (lambda : ℝ) (w : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (t : ℝ), 1 + t * lambda ≠ 0 → w t = (1 + t * lambda) • Lasso.scaledDualPath lambda w t

entries.name: Lasso.scaledPrimalPath
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → (ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι

entries.name: Lasso.scaledPrimalPath_ae_differentiable
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} {s : ℝ}, 0 < s → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnNonnegativeCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → ∀ᵐ (τ : ℝ), τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 s → DifferentiableAt ℝ (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) τ

entries.name: Lasso.scaledPrimalPath_coord_affine_at_differentiable
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ScaledPrimalPathLocallyAffineAtDifferentiable x_lasso → ∀ (i : ι) (μ : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun u' => u' * (x_lasso u').ofLp i) μ → ∃ a b, ∀ᶠ (t : ℝ) in nhds μ, t * (x_lasso t).ofLp i = a * t + b

entries.name: Lasso.scaledPrimalPath_deriv_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.LocallyLipschitzOnCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∃ C > 0, ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 s, ‖deriv (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) τ‖ ≤ C

entries.name: Lasso.scaledPrimalPath_deriv_locally_constant
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ScaledPrimalPathLocallyAffineAtDifferentiable x_lasso → ∀ (τ' : ℝ) (i' : ι), 0 ≤ τ' → DifferentiableAt ℝ (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) τ' → ∃ ε > 0, ∀ (t : ℝ), |t - τ'| < ε → deriv (fun u' => (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso u').ofLp i') t = deriv (fun u' => (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso u').ofLp i') τ'

entries.name: Lasso.scaledPrimalPath_regular_of_path_regular
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsPositiveLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnPositiveCompacts x_lasso → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnNonnegativeCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso)

entries.name: Lasso.scaled_diff_quot_eq_matVec
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.matVec M y = r → ∀ (wt zt : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (s : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ (ν : ℝ), 0 ≤ ν → wt ν = -s ν • r + Lasso.ones + Lasso.matVec M (zt ν)) → ∀ (μ h : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → 0 < h → h⁻¹ • (wt (μ + h) - wt μ) = Lasso.matVec M (-((s (μ + h) - s μ) / h) • y + h⁻¹ • (zt (μ + h) - zt μ))

entries.name: Lasso.scaled_dual_lcp_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (z w : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), 0 ≤ lambda → (∀ (μ : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → Lasso.isParametricLCP M r lambda μ (z μ) (w μ)) → ∀ (μ : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → have wt := Lasso.scaledDualPath lambda w μ; have zt := (1 / (1 + μ * lambda)) • z μ; have s := μ / (1 + μ * lambda); wt = -s • r + Lasso.ones + Lasso.matVec M zt ∧ Lasso.Nonnegative wt ∧ Lasso.Nonnegative zt ∧ inner ℝ wt zt = 0

entries.name: Lasso.scaled_dual_lcp_key_ineq
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.IsPositiveSemidefinite M → ∀ (wt zt : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (s : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ (μ : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → wt μ = -s μ • r + Lasso.ones + Lasso.matVec M (zt μ) ∧ Lasso.Nonnegative (wt μ) ∧ Lasso.Nonnegative (zt μ) ∧ inner ℝ (wt μ) (zt μ) = 0) → ∀ {μ₁ μ₂ : ℝ}, 0 ≤ μ₁ → 0 ≤ μ₂ → inner ℝ (zt μ₁ - zt μ₂) (Lasso.matVec M (zt μ₁ - zt μ₂)) ≤ |s μ₁ - s μ₂| * |inner ℝ r (zt μ₁ - zt μ₂)|

entries.name: Lasso.scaled_dual_lcp_s_diff_bound

entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} {nextA : (n : ℕ) → Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 n × 𝓞 → 𝓐} {h_next : ∀ (n : ℕ), Measurable (nextA n)}, (Learning.detAlgorithm nextA h_next).p0 = ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.deterministic (fun o => nextA 0 (default, o)) ⋯

entries.name: Learning.p0_eq_deterministic
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨) [inst : Learning.IsDeterministicAlg alg], alg.p0 = ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.deterministic (Learning.actionZero alg) ⋯

entries.name: Learning.p0_eq_dirac
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {𝓨 : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 𝓨) [h_det : Learning.IsDeterministicAlg alg], alg.p0 = MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac (Learning.actionZero alg)

entries.name: Learning.policy_eq_deterministic
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨) [h_det : Learning.IsDeterministicAlg alg] (n : ℕ), alg.policy n = ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.deterministic (Learning.nextAction alg n) ⋯

entries.name: Learning.pullCount
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {Ω : Type u_4} → [DecidableEq 𝓐] → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) → 𝓐 → ℕ → Ω → ℕ

entries.name: Learning.pullCount'
entries.statement: {𝓞 : Type u_1} → {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {R : Type u_3} → [DecidableEq 𝓐] → (n : ℕ) → Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 R n → 𝓐 → ℕ

entries.name: Learning.pullCount'_eq_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] (n : ℕ) (h : Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 R n) (a : 𝓐), Learning.pullCount' n h a = ∑ s, if (h s).action = a then 1 else 0

entries.name: Learning.pullCount'_mono
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω} {n m : ℕ}, n ≤ m → Learning.pullCount' n (Learning.history O A R' n ω) a ≤ Learning.pullCount' m (Learning.history O A R' m ω) a

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_action_eq_pullCount_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A (A t ω) (t + 1) ω = Learning.pullCount A (A t ω) t ω + 1

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {t : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.pullCount A a (t + 1) ω = Learning.pullCount A a t ω + if A t ω = a then 1 else 0

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_add_one_eq_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m n : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ↑n → Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω = m

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_add_one_eq_pullCount'
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {n : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω = Learning.pullCount' n (fun i => (A (↑i) ω, R' (↑i) ω)) a

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_congr
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {n : ℕ} {ω ω' : Ω}, (∀ i ≤ n, A i ω = A i ω') → Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω = Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω'

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_eq_comp_history
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} (a : 𝓐) (n : ℕ), Learning.pullCount A a n = (fun h => Learning.pullCount' n h a) ∘ Learning.history O A R' n

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_eq_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m n : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, m ≠ 0 → Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ↑n → Learning.pullCount A a n ω = m - 1

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_eq_pullCount'
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {n : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.pullCount A a n ω = Learning.pullCount' n (Learning.history O A R' n ω) a

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_eq_pullCount_of_action_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {t : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, A t ω ≠ a → Learning.pullCount A a (t + 1) ω = Learning.pullCount A a t ω

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_eq_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A a t ω = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range t, if A s ω = a then 1 else 0

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_le
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A a t ω ≤ t

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_le_add
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (n C : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A a n ω ≤ C + 1 + ∑ s ∈ Finset.range n, {s | A s ω = a ∧ C < Learning.pullCount A a s ω}.indicator 1 s

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_lt_of_forall_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {n t : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, (∀ (s : ℕ), Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω ≠ t) → t ≠ 0 → Learning.pullCount A a n ω < t

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_lt_of_le_stepsUntil
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) {n m : ℕ} (ω : Ω), (∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m) → ↑n < Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω → Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω < m

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_mono
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) {n m : ℕ}, n ≤ m → ∀ (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A a n ω ≤ Learning.pullCount A a m ω

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω}, Learning.pullCount A a 1 ω = if A 0 ω = a then 1 else 0

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_stepsUntil
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, m ≠ 0 → (∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m) → Learning.pullCount A a (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω).toNat ω = m - 1

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_stepsUntil_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, (∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m) → Learning.pullCount A a (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω + 1).toNat ω = m

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐), Learning.pullCount A a 0 = 0

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_zero_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A a 0 ω = 0

entries.name: Learning.randomSampling
entries.statement: {𝓞 : Type u_1} → {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {𝓨 : Type u_3} → {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} → {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} → {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} → (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure 𝓐) → [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] → Learning.Algorithm 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨

entries.name: Learning.randomSampling_p0
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {𝓨 : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure 𝓐) [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ], (Learning.randomSampling μ).p0 = μ

entries.name: Learning.randomSampling_policy
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure 𝓐) [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (x : ℕ), (Learning.randomSampling μ).policy x = ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.const (Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 x × 𝓞) μ

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {R : Type u_3} → {Ω : Type u_4} → [DecidableEq 𝓐] → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) → (ℕ → Ω → R) → 𝓐 → ℕ → Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R) → R

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCountUntil
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {R : Type u_3} → {Ω : Type u_4} → [DecidableEq 𝓐] → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) → (ℕ → Ω → R) → ℕ → Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R) → 𝓐 × ℕ → R

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCountUntil_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)), Learning.rewardByCountUntil A R' (t + 1) ω = Function.update (Learning.rewardByCountUntil A R' t ω) (A t ω.1, Learning.pullCount A (A t ω.1) t ω.1) (R' t ω.1)

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCountUntil_apply_of_lt_pullCount
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {m t : ℕ} {ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)}, m < Learning.pullCount A a t ω.1 → Learning.rewardByCountUntil A R' t ω (a, m) = Learning.rewardByCount A R' a (m + 1) ω

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCountUntil_apply_of_pullCount_le
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {m t : ℕ} {ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)}, Learning.pullCount A a t ω.1 ≤ m → Learning.rewardByCountUntil A R' t ω (a, m) = ω.2 (m + 1) a

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCountUntil_congr
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {x : Ω} {z z' : ℕ → 𝓐 → R} (t : ℕ) (p : 𝓐 × ℕ), z (p.2 + 1) p.1 = z' (p.2 + 1) p.1 → Learning.rewardByCountUntil A R' t (x, z) p = Learning.rewardByCountUntil A R' t (x, z') p

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCountUntil_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} (ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)), Learning.rewardByCountUntil A R' 0 ω = fun p => ω.2 (p.2 + 1) p.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_eq_add
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} [inst_1 : AddMonoid R] (a : 𝓐) (m : ℕ), Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m = ({ω | Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 ≠ ⊤}.indicator fun ω => R' (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1).toNat ω.1) + {ω | Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 = ⊤}.indicator fun ω => ω.2 m a

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_eq_ite
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} (a : 𝓐) (m : ℕ) (ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)), Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m ω = if Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 = ⊤ then ω.2 m a else R' (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1).toNat ω.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_eq_stoppedValue
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 ≠ ⊤ → Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m ω = MeasureTheory.stoppedValue R' (Learning.stepsUntil A a m) ω.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {m n : ℕ} {ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 = ↑n → Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m ω = R' n ω.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_top
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 = ⊤ → Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m ω = ω.2 m a

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_ne_top
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 ≠ ⊤ → Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m ω = R' (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1).toNat ω.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_pullCount_add_one_eq_reward
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)), Learning.rewardByCount A R' (A t ω.1) (Learning.pullCount A (A t ω.1) t ω.1 + 1) ω = R' t ω.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} (a : 𝓐) (ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)), Learning.rewardByCount A R' a 0 ω = if A 0 ω.1 = a then ω.2 0 a else R' 0 ω.1

entries.name: Learning.roundRobinAlgorithm
entries.statement: {𝓞 : Type u_1} → {𝓨 : Type u_2} → {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} → {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} → (K : ℕ) → [NeZero K] → Learning.Algorithm 𝓞 (Fin K) 𝓨

entries.name: Learning.setOf_action_eq_and_pullCount_eq_eq_preimage
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} (n : ℕ) (b : 𝓐) (k : ℕ), {x | A n x = b ∧ Learning.pullCount A b n x = k} = (fun x => ((Learning.history O A R' n x, O n x), A n x)) ⁻¹' {u | u.2 = b ∧ Learning.pullCount' n u.1.1 b = k}

entries.name: Learning.sigmaHistory
entries.statement: {𝓞 : Type u_1} → {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {𝓨 : Type u_3} → {Ω : Type u_4} → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓞) → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓨) → ℕ → Ω → (n : ℕ) × Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 n

entries.name: Learning.sigmaHistory_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {X : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.sigmaHistory O X Y n ω = ⟨n, Learning.history O X Y n ω⟩

entries.name: Learning.snd_eval_comp_history
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {𝓨 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} (n : ℕ), (fun x => (x ⟨n, ⋯⟩).2) ∘ Learning.history A Y n = Y n

entries.name: Learning.stationaryEnv
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {𝓨 : Type u_3} → {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} → {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} → (ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 𝓨) → [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] → Learning.Environment Unit 𝓐 𝓨

entries.name: Learning.step
entries.statement: {𝓞 : Type u_1} → {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {𝓨 : Type u_3} → {Ω : Type u_4} → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓞) → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓨) → ℕ → Ω → Learning.Round 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨

entries.name: Learning.stepKernel
entries.statement: {𝓞 : Type u_1} → {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {𝓨 : Type u_3} → {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} → {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} → {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} → Learning.Algorithm 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 → Learning.Environment 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 → (n : ℕ) → ProbabilityTheory.Kernel (Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 n) (Learning.Round 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨)

entries.name: Learning.stepKernel_def
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨) (env : Learning.Environment 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨) (n : ℕ), Learning.stepKernel alg env n = (env.obs n).compProd ((alg.policy n).compProd (env.feedback n))

entries.name: Learning.stepKernel_stationaryEnv
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (alg : Learning.Algorithm Unit 𝓐 𝓨) (η : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 𝓨) [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel η] (n : ℕ), Learning.stepKernel alg (Learning.stationaryEnv η) n = (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.const (Learning.Hist Unit 𝓐 𝓨 n) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac ())).compProd ((alg.policy n).compProd (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkLeft (Learning.Hist Unit 𝓐 𝓨 n × Unit) η))

entries.name: Learning.stepKernel_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨) (env : Learning.Environment 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨) (h : Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 0), (Learning.stepKernel alg env 0) h = env.obs0.compProd (alg.p0.compProd env.ν0)

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {Ω : Type u_4} → [DecidableEq 𝓐] → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) → 𝓐 → ℕ → Ω → ℕ∞

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_congr
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m n : ℕ} {ω ω' : Ω}, (∀ i ≤ n, A i ω = A i ω') → (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ↑n ↔ Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω' = ↑n)

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_dite
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (m : ℕ) (ω : Ω) [inst_1 : Decidable (∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m)], Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = if h : ∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m then ↑(Nat.find h) else ⊤

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_iff
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω} (n : ℕ), Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ↑n ↔ Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω = m ∧ ∀ k < n, Learning.pullCount A a (k + 1) ω < m

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_iff'
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, m ≠ 0 → ∀ (n : ℕ), Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ↑n ↔ A n ω = a ∧ Learning.pullCount A a n ω = m - 1

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_leastGE
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {m : ℕ} (a : 𝓐), m ≠ 0 → Learning.stepsUntil A a m = MeasureTheory.leastGE (fun n ω => Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω) m

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_top_iff
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ⊤ ↔ ∀ (s : ℕ), Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω ≠ m

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_zero_iff
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = 0 ↔ m = 0 ∧ A 0 ω ≠ a ∨ m = 1 ∧ A 0 ω = a

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_mono
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (ω : Ω) {n m : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → n ≤ m → Learning.stepsUntil A a n ω ≤ Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_ne_top
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, (∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m) → Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω ≠ ⊤

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_one_of_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω}, A 0 ω = a → Learning.stepsUntil A a 1 ω = 0

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_pullCount_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (ω : Ω) (t : ℕ), Learning.stepsUntil A (A t ω) (Learning.pullCount A (A t ω) (t + 1) ω) ω = ↑t

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_pullCount_le
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (ω : Ω) (a : 𝓐) (t : ℕ), Learning.stepsUntil A a (Learning.pullCount A a (t + 1) ω) ω ≤ ↑t

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_zero_of_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω}, A 0 ω = a → Learning.stepsUntil A a 0 ω = ⊤

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_zero_of_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω}, A 0 ω ≠ a → Learning.stepsUntil A a 0 ω = 0

entries.name: Learning.stoppedHistMeasure
entries.statement: {𝓞 : Type u_1} → {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {𝓨 : Type u_3} → {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} → {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} → {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} → Learning.Algorithm 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 → Learning.Environment 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 → Set ((n : ℕ) × Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 n) → MeasureTheory.Measure ((n : ℕ) × Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 n)

entries.name: Learning.stronglyAdapted_pullCount_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {mR : MeasurableSpace R} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓞 𝓐 R} {env : Learning.Environment 𝓞 𝓐 R} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq O A R' alg env P) (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.StronglyAdapted h.filtration fun n => Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1)

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {𝓨 : Type u_3} → {Ω : Type u_4} → [DecidableEq 𝓐] → [AddCommGroup 𝓨] → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓨) → 𝓐 → ℕ → Ω → 𝓨

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards'
entries.statement: {𝓞 : Type u_1} → {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {𝓨 : Type u_3} → [DecidableEq 𝓐] → [AddCommGroup 𝓨] → (n : ℕ) → Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 n → 𝓐 → 𝓨

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup 𝓨] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {t : ℕ} {ω : Ω} {R : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨}, Learning.sumRewards A R a (t + 1) ω = Learning.sumRewards A R a t ω + if A t ω = a then R t ω else 0

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_add_one_eq_sumRewards'
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {n : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.sumRewards A R' a (n + 1) ω = Learning.sumRewards' n (fun i => (A (↑i) ω, R' (↑i) ω)) a

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_eq_comp_history
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup 𝓨] {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} (a : 𝓐) (n : ℕ), Learning.sumRewards A R a n = (fun h => Learning.sumRewards' n h a) ∘ Learning.history O A R n

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_eq_of_pullCount_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup 𝓨] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω} {R : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} {s t : ℕ}, Learning.pullCount A a s ω = Learning.pullCount A a t ω → Learning.sumRewards A R a s ω = Learning.sumRewards A R a t ω

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_eq_pullCount_mul_empMean
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {t : ℕ} {R : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.pullCount A a t ω ≠ 0 → Learning.sumRewards A R a t ω = ↑(Learning.pullCount A a t ω) * Learning.empMean A R a t ω

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_eq_sumRewards'
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup 𝓨] {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {R : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} {n : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.sumRewards A R a n ω = Learning.sumRewards' n (Learning.history O A R n ω) a

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_sub_pullCount_mul_eq_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {n : ℕ} {ω : Ω} {R' : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (c : 𝓐 → ℝ), Learning.sumRewards A R' a (n + 1) ω - ↑(Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω) * c a = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), if A i ω = a then R' i ω - c a else 0

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_sub_pullCount_smul_eq_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup 𝓨] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {n : ℕ} {ω : Ω} {R : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} (c : 𝓐 → 𝓨), Learning.sumRewards A R a (n + 1) ω - Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω • c a = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), if A i ω = a then R i ω - c a else 0

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup 𝓨] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {R : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨}, Learning.sumRewards A R a 0 = 0

entries.name: Learning.sum_actionIndicator
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype 𝓐] (A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) (j : ℕ) (ω : Ω), ∑ k, Learning.actionIndicator A k j ω = 1

entries.name: Learning.sum_actionIndicator_eq_pullCount
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] (A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) (k : 𝓐) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, Learning.actionIndicator A k j ω = ↑(Learning.pullCount A k n ω)

entries.name: Learning.sum_actionIndicator_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] (A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (k : 𝓐) (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range t, Learning.actionIndicator A k j ω * Y j ω = Learning.sumRewards A Y k t ω

entries.name: Learning.sum_actionIndicator_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_3} {𝓨 : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup 𝓨] [inst_2 : Module ℝ 𝓨] (A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) (Y : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨) (k : 𝓐) (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range t, Learning.actionIndicator A k j ω • Y j ω = Learning.sumRewards A Y k t ω

entries.name: Learning.sum_comp_pullCount
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} [inst_1 : Fintype 𝓐] [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid R] (f : ℕ → R) (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω), ∑ s ∈ Finset.range t, f (Learning.pullCount A (A s ω) s ω) = ∑ a, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (Learning.pullCount A a t ω), f j

entries.name: Learning.sum_pullCount'
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] [inst_1 : Fintype 𝓐] (n : ℕ) (h : Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 ℝ n), ∑ a, Learning.pullCount' n h a = n

entries.name: Learning.sum_pullCount_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} [inst_1 : Fintype 𝓐] [inst_2 : Semiring R] (ω : Ω) (f : 𝓐 → R) (t : ℕ), ∑ a, ↑(Learning.pullCount A a t ω) * f a = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range t, f (A s ω)

entries.name: Learning.sum_rewardByCount_eq_sumRewards
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup 𝓨] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} (a : 𝓐) (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → 𝓨)), ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Learning.pullCount A a t ω.1), Learning.rewardByCount A R a m ω = Learning.sumRewards A R a t ω.1

entries.statement: ∀ {𝓔 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} [inst : MeasurableSpace 𝓔] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨] {Q : MeasureTheory.Measure 𝓔} [inst_3 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure Q] {κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel (𝓔 × 𝓐) 𝓨} [inst_4 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel κ], (Learning.bayesStationaryEnv Q κ).ν0 = κ

entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (env : Learning.Environment 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨) [inst : Learning.IsDeterministicEnv env], env.ν0 = ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.deterministic (Learning.feedbackFunZero env) ⋯

entries.name: Learning.ν0_eq_feedbackCondAction
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (env : Learning.Environment 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨) [inst : Learning.IsObliviousEnv env], env.ν0 = ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkLeft 𝓞 (Learning.feedbackCondAction env 0)

entries.name: Learning.ν0_obliviousEnv

entries.statement: ∀ {n : Type u_1} {p : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : Fintype p] [inst_2 : DecidableEq p] (Sigma Sigma_hat Sigma_hat_dagger : Matrix p p ℝ), (1 - Sigma_hat_dagger * Sigma_hat).IsSymm → ∀ (σ_sq : ℝ) (m β : EuclideanSpace ℝ p), m.ofLp = (Sigma_hat_dagger * Sigma_hat).mulVec β.ofLp → ∀ (cov_mat : Matrix p p ℝ), cov_mat = (σ_sq / ↑(Fintype.card n)) • Sigma_hat_dagger → (m.ofLp - β.ofLp) ⬝ᵥ Sigma.mulVec (m.ofLp - β.ofLp) = β.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((1 - Sigma_hat_dagger * Sigma_hat) * Sigma * (1 - Sigma_hat_dagger * Sigma_hat)).mulVec β.ofLp ∧ (cov_mat * Sigma).trace = σ_sq / ↑(Fintype.card n) * (Sigma_hat_dagger * Sigma).trace

entries.name: NTK.charFun_map_deepEval
entries.statement: ∀ (d m L : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), Measurable φ → ∀ (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (t : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), MeasureTheory.charFun (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun q => WithLp.toLp 2 fun α => √(↑n)⁻¹ * ∑ j, q.2.1 ↑j * φ (NTK.deepPreactivation d m n φ X (fun k => if h : k < L then q.1 ⟨k, h⟩ else 0) (L - 1) α j)) ((MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x => MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1).prod ((MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1).prod (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1)))) t = ∫ (w : Fin L → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ), Complex.exp (-↑(t.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (have this := fun α β => (↑n)⁻¹ * ∑ j, φ (NTK.deepPreactivation d m n φ X (fun k => if h : k < L then w ⟨k, h⟩ else 0) (L - 1) α j) * φ (NTK.deepPreactivation d m n φ X (fun k => if h : k < L then w ⟨k, h⟩ else 0) (L - 1) β j); this).mulVec t.ofLp) / 2) ∂MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x => MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1
