entries.statement: {d m : ℕ} → (ℝ → ℝ) → (Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ

entries.name: NTK.limitingCovariance_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (α β : Fin m), NTK.limitingCovariance φ X α β = ∫ (w : Fin d → ℝ), φ (w ⊙ X α) * φ (w ⊙ X β) ∂NTK.gaussianRowMeasure d

entries.name: NTK.limitingCovariance_isHermitian
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ), (NTK.limitingCovariance φ X).IsHermitian

entries.name: NTK.limitingCovariance_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ), Measurable φ → (∀ (α : Fin m), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun w => φ (w ⊙ X α)) 2 (NTK.gaussianRowMeasure d)) → ∀ (c : Fin m → ℝ), 0 ≤ c ⬝ᵥ (NTK.limitingCovariance φ X).mulVec c

entries.name: NTK.limitingCovariance_posSemidef
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ), Measurable φ → (∀ (α : Fin m), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun w => φ (w ⊙ X α)) 2 (NTK.gaussianRowMeasure d)) → (NTK.limitingCovariance φ X).PosSemidef

entries.name: NTK.limitingNTK
entries.statement: {d : ℕ} → (ℝ → ℝ) → (Fin d → ℝ) → (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ

entries.name: NTK.limitingNTK_symm
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (σ' : ℝ → ℝ) (x x' : Fin d → ℝ), NTK.limitingNTK σ' x x' = NTK.limitingNTK σ' x' x

entries.name: NTK.limitingRecurrence_isHermitian_multivariate
entries.statement: ∀ (σw σb : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (K : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ), (have this := fun α β => σb ^ 2 + σw ^ 2 * ∫ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), φ (z.ofLp α) * φ (z.ofLp β) ∂ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K; this).IsHermitian

entries.name: NTK.limitingRecurrence_nonneg_multivariate
entries.statement: ∀ (σw σb : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), Measurable φ → ∀ (K : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K)], (∀ (α : Fin m), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun z => φ (z.ofLp α)) 2 (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K)) → ∀ (c : Fin m → ℝ), 0 ≤ c ⬝ᵥ Matrix.mulVec (fun α β => σb ^ 2 + σw ^ 2 * ∫ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), φ (z.ofLp α) * φ (z.ofLp β) ∂ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K) c

entries.name: NTK.limitingRecurrence_posSemidef_multivariate
entries.statement: ∀ (σw σb : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), Measurable φ → ∀ (K : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K)], (∀ (α : Fin m), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun z => φ (z.ofLp α)) 2 (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K)) → (have this := fun α β => σb ^ 2 + σw ^ 2 * ∫ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), φ (z.ofLp α) * φ (z.ofLp β) ∂ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K; this).PosSemidef

entries.name: NTK.limitingRecurrence_relu_bivariate
entries.statement: ∀ (σw σb Φαα Φββ Φαβ : ℝ), 0 < Φαα → 0 < Φββ → (have this := !![Φαα, Φαβ; Φαβ, Φββ]; this).PosSemidef → have ρ := Φαβ / √(Φαα * Φββ); σb ^ 2 + σw ^ 2 * ∫ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), NTK.relu (z.ofLp 0) * NTK.relu (z.ofLp 1) ∂ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 !![Φαα, Φαβ; Φαβ, Φββ] = σb ^ 2 + σw ^ 2 * (√(Φαα * Φββ) / (2 * Real.pi) * (√(1 - ρ ^ 2) + ρ * (Real.pi / 2 + Real.arcsin ρ)))

entries.name: NTK.linearization
entries.statement: {σ σ' : ℝ → ℝ} → {d m : ℕ} → (Fin m → ℝ) → (Fin d → ℝ) → (Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) → (Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ

entries.name: NTK.linearization_relu_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (outerCoeffs : Fin m → ℝ) (x : Fin d → ℝ) (W₀ W : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (σ' : ℝ → ℝ), NTK.linearization outerCoeffs x W₀ W = √(↑m)⁻¹ * ∑ j, outerCoeffs j * σ' (∑ k, W₀ j k * x k) * ∑ k, W j k * x k

entries.name: NTK.map_cholesky2x2_stdGaussian
entries.statement: ∀ ρ ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1, have L := !![1, 0; ρ, √(1 - ρ ^ 2)]; MeasureTheory.Measure.map (⇑(Matrix.toEuclideanCLM L)) (ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) = ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 !![1, ρ; ρ, 1]

entries.name: NTK.map_deepEval_snd_eq_multivariateGaussian
entries.statement: ∀ (d m n L : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (w : Fin L → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun r => WithLp.toLp 2 fun α => √(↑n)⁻¹ * ∑ j, r.1 ↑j * φ (NTK.deepPreactivation d m n φ X (fun k => if h : k < L then w ⟨k, h⟩ else 0) (L - 1) α j)) ((MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1).prod (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1)) = ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (have this := fun α β => (↑n)⁻¹ * ∑ j, φ (NTK.deepPreactivation d m n φ X (fun k => if h : k < L then w ⟨k, h⟩ else 0) (L - 1) α j) * φ (NTK.deepPreactivation d m n φ X (fun k => if h : k < L then w ⟨k, h⟩ else 0) (L - 1) β j); this)

entries.name: NTK.map_diagScale2x2_multivariateGaussian
entries.statement: ∀ (Φαα Φββ Φαβ : ℝ), 0 < Φαα → 0 < Φββ → (have this := !![Φαα, Φαβ; Φαβ, Φββ]; this).PosSemidef → have ρ := Φαβ / √(Φαα * Φββ); have D := !![√Φαα, 0; 0, √Φββ]; MeasureTheory.Measure.map (⇑(Matrix.toEuclideanCLM D)) (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 !![1, ρ; ρ, 1]) = ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 !![Φαα, Φαβ; Φαβ, Φββ]

entries.name: NTK.map_gaussianInit_row
entries.statement: ∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : Fin n), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun W => W i) (NTK.gaussianInit n d) = NTK.gaussianRowMeasure d

entries.name: NTK.map_gaussianReadoutMeasure_coord
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun a => a i) (NTK.gaussianReadoutMeasure n) = ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1

entries.name: NTK.map_gaussianReadoutMeasure_inner
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → ℝ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun a => ∑ i, a i * v i) (NTK.gaussianReadoutMeasure n) = ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (∑ i, v i ^ 2).toNNReal

entries.name: NTK.map_gaussianRowMeasure_dot
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → ℝ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun w => ∑ k, w k * x k) (NTK.gaussianRowMeasure d) = ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (x ⊙ x).toNNReal

entries.name: NTK.map_gaussianRowMeasure_innerProduct
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → ℝ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun w => w ⊙ x) (NTK.gaussianRowMeasure d) = ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (x ⊙ x).toNNReal

entries.name: NTK.map_infinitePi_input_preactivations
entries.statement: ∀ (d m : ℕ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun W j => WithLp.toLp 2 fun α => √(↑d)⁻¹ * ∑ k, W j ↑k * X α k) (MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1) = MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 fun α β => (↑d)⁻¹ * X α ⊙ X β

entries.name: NTK.map_infinitePi_real_eq_gaussianReadoutMeasure
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun rows i => rows ↑i) (MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1) = NTK.gaussianReadoutMeasure n

entries.name: NTK.map_infinitePi_rows_eq_gaussianInit
entries.statement: ∀ (n d : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun rows i => rows ↑i) (MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => NTK.gaussianRowMeasure d) = NTK.gaussianInit n d

entries.name: NTK.map_pi_eval_two
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) {μ : Fin d → MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ} [∀ (i : Fin d), MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)], MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun t => (t ⟨0, ⋯⟩, t ⟨1, ⋯⟩)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi μ) = (μ ⟨0, ⋯⟩).prod (μ ⟨1, ⋯⟩)

entries.name: NTK.map_projection_tendsto_gaussianReal
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (hφ_meas : Measurable φ), (∀ (α : Fin m), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun w => φ (w ⊙ X α)) 2 (NTK.gaussianRowMeasure d)) → ∀ (u : Fin m → ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ⟨MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun p => ∑ α, u α * NTK.evalSingle φ p.1 p.2 (X α)) (NTK.initMeasure n d), ⋯⟩) Filter.atTop (nhds ⟨ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (u ⬝ᵥ (NTK.limitingCovariance φ X).mulVec u).toNNReal, ⋯⟩)

entries.name: NTK.map_readout_inner_evalVector
entries.statement: ∀ {d n m : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (W : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (t : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun a => inner ℝ t (NTK.evalVector φ W a X)) (NTK.gaussianReadoutMeasure n) = ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (t.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (NTK.empiricalCovariance n φ W X).mulVec t.ofLp).toNNReal

entries.name: NTK.map_readout_projection_eq_gaussianReal
entries.statement: ∀ {d n m : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (W : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (c : Fin m → ℝ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun a => ∑ α, c α * NTK.evalSingle φ W a (X α)) (NTK.gaussianReadoutMeasure n) = ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (c ⬝ᵥ (NTK.empiricalCovariance n φ W X).mulVec c).toNNReal

entries.name: NTK.measurable_cov_summand
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ), Measurable φ → ∀ (x x' : Fin d → ℝ), Measurable fun w => φ (w ⊙ x) * φ (w ⊙ x')

entries.name: NTK.measurable_deepEval
entries.statement: ∀ (d m L : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), Measurable φ → ∀ (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (n : ℕ), Measurable fun q => WithLp.toLp 2 fun α => √(↑n)⁻¹ * ∑ j, q.2.1 ↑j * φ (NTK.deepPreactivation d m n φ X (fun k => if h : k < L then q.1 ⟨k, h⟩ else 0) (L - 1) α j)

entries.name: NTK.measurable_deepPreactivation
entries.statement: ∀ (d m n L : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), Measurable φ → ∀ (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (ℓ : ℕ) (α : Fin m) (j : Fin n), Measurable fun w => NTK.deepPreactivation d m n φ X (fun k => if h : k < L then w ⟨k, h⟩ else 0) ℓ α j

entries.name: NTK.measurable_exp_quadratic_empiricalCovariance
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), Measurable φ → ∀ (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (t : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), Measurable fun W => Complex.exp (-↑(t.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (NTK.empiricalCovariance n φ W X).mulVec t.ofLp) / 2)

entries.name: NTK.measurable_innerProduct_left
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → ℝ), Measurable fun w => w ⊙ x

entries.name: NTK.measurable_ntkSummand
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} {σ' : ℝ → ℝ}, Measurable σ' → ∀ (x x' : Fin d → ℝ), Measurable (NTK.ntkSummand σ' x x')

entries.name: NTK.measurable_reluIndicator
entries.statement: Measurable NTK.reluIndicator

entries.name: NTK.measurable_sequential_preactivation
entries.statement: ∀ (σw σb : ℝ) (n m : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), Measurable φ → Measurable fun p => WithLp.toLp 2 fun α => σb * p.2.2 + σw * √(↑n)⁻¹ * ∑ j, p.2.1 j * φ ((p.1 ↑j).ofLp α)

entries.name: NTK.measurable_signAmbiguous_card
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (r : ℝ) (x : Fin d → ℝ), Measurable fun W₀ => ↑(NTK.signAmbiguous r x W₀).card

entries.name: NTK.memLp_activation_coordinate_of_polynomial_growth
entries.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (K : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), Measurable φ → ∀ (C : ℝ), 0 ≤ C → ∀ (p : ℕ), 0 < p → (∀ (x : ℝ), |φ x| ≤ C * (1 + |x| ^ p)) → ∀ (α : Fin m), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun z => φ (z.ofLp α)) 2 (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K)

entries.name: NTK.multivariateGaussian_average_tendsto_integral_multivariate
entries.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (K : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K)] (g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) → ℝ), Measurable g → MeasureTheory.Integrable g (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K) → ∀ᵐ (seq : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) ∂MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K, Filter.Tendsto (fun width => (↑width)⁻¹ * ∑ j, g (seq ↑j)) Filter.atTop (nhds (∫ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), g z ∂ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K))

entries.name: NTK.multivariateGaussian_pi_eq_kronecker
entries.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (Φ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ), Φ.PosSemidef → MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun Y => WithLp.toLp 2 fun p => (Y p.2).ofLp p.1) (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 Φ) = ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => x1 * x2) Φ 1)

entries.name: NTK.norm_charFun_deepEval_le_one
entries.statement: ∀ (d m n L : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (w : Fin L → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (t : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), ‖Complex.exp (-↑(t.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (have this := fun α β => (↑n)⁻¹ * ∑ j, φ (NTK.deepPreactivation d m n φ X (fun k => if h : k < L then w ⟨k, h⟩ else 0) (L - 1) α j) * φ (NTK.deepPreactivation d m n φ X (fun k => if h : k < L then w ⟨k, h⟩ else 0) (L - 1) β j); this).mulVec t.ofLp) / 2)‖ ≤ 1

entries.name: NTK.norm_charFun_readout_le_one
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (W : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (t : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), ‖Complex.exp (-↑(t.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (NTK.empiricalCovariance n φ W X).mulVec t.ofLp) / 2)‖ ≤ 1

entries.name: NTK.norm_exp_neg_ofReal_div_two_le_one
entries.statement: ∀ {s : ℝ}, 0 ≤ s → ‖Complex.exp (-↑s / 2)‖ ≤ 1

entries.name: NTK.norm_sq_eq_innerProduct
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x.ofLp ⊙ x.ofLp

entries.name: NTK.ntkDomain
entries.statement: (d : ℕ) → Set (Fin d → ℝ)

entries.name: NTK.ntkDomain_subset_sphere
entries.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ), NTK.ntkDomain d ⊆ {x | x ⊙ x = 1}

entries.name: NTK.ntkSummand
entries.statement: {d : ℕ} → (ℝ → ℝ) → (Fin d → ℝ) → (Fin d → ℝ) → (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ

entries.name: NTK.ntk_convergence
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (σ' : ℝ → ℝ), Measurable σ' → (∃ C, ∀ (z : ℝ), |σ' z| ≤ C) → ∀ (x x' : Fin d → ℝ), ∀ᵐ (rows : ℕ → Fin d → ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => NTK.gaussianRowMeasure d, Filter.Tendsto (fun width => NTK.empiricalNTKFromRows σ' rows width x x') Filter.atTop (nhds (NTK.limitingNTK σ' x x'))

entries.name: NTK.ofLp_innerProduct_eq_inner
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → ℝ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), y.ofLp ⊙ x = inner ℝ y (WithLp.toLp 2 x)

entries.name: NTK.outputMeasure
entries.statement: {m : ℕ} → ℕ → (d : ℕ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → (Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) → MeasureTheory.Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))

entries.name: NTK.outputMeasure_eq_map
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} (n d : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ), NTK.outputMeasure n d φ X = MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun p => NTK.evalVector φ p.1 p.2 X) (NTK.initMeasure n d)

entries.name: NTK.outputMeasure_tendsto_multivariateGaussian
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (hφ_meas : Measurable φ), (∀ (α : Fin m), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun w => φ (w ⊙ X α)) 2 (NTK.gaussianRowMeasure d)) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ⟨NTK.outputMeasure n d φ X, ⋯⟩) Filter.atTop (nhds ⟨ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (NTK.limitingCovariance φ X), ⋯⟩)

entries.name: NTK.pearsonRho_mem_Icc
entries.statement: ∀ (Φαα Φββ Φαβ : ℝ), 0 < Φαα → 0 < Φββ → (have this := !![Φαα, Φαβ; Φαβ, Φββ]; this).PosSemidef → Φαβ / √(Φαα * Φββ) ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1

entries.name: NTK.prob_halfspace_intersect
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (x x' : Fin d → ℝ), x ⊙ x = 1 → x' ⊙ x' = 1 → ∫ (w : Fin d → ℝ), NTK.reluIndicator (w ⊙ x) * NTK.reluIndicator (w ⊙ x') ∂NTK.gaussianRowMeasure d = (Real.pi - Real.arccos (x ⊙ x')) / (2 * Real.pi)

entries.name: NTK.prob_signAmbiguous_le_tau
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → ℝ), 0 < x ⊙ x → ∀ (τ : ℝ), 0 < τ → (NTK.gaussianRowMeasure d).real {w | |∑ k, w k * x k| ≤ τ * √(x ⊙ x)} ≤ τ

entries.name: NTK.projectionCoeff
entries.statement: {d m : ℕ} → (n : ℕ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → (Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) → (Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) → (Fin m → ℝ) → Fin n → ℝ

entries.name: NTK.projectionCoeff_eq_normalized_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (W : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (c : Fin m → ℝ) (i : Fin n), NTK.projectionCoeff n φ W X c i = √(↑n)⁻¹ * ∑ α, c α * φ (W i ⊙ X α)

entries.name: NTK.projectionCoeff_measurable
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), Measurable φ → ∀ (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (c : Fin m → ℝ) (i : Fin n), Measurable fun W => NTK.projectionCoeff n φ W X c i

entries.name: NTK.projectionCoeff_sq
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (W : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (c : Fin m → ℝ) (i : Fin n), NTK.projectionCoeff n φ W X c i ^ 2 = (↑n)⁻¹ * ∑ α, ∑ β, c α * c β * (φ (W i ⊙ X α) * φ (W i ⊙ X β))

entries.name: NTK.projection_eq_sum_projectionCoeff
entries.statement: ∀ {d n m : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (W : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (c : Fin m → ℝ), ∑ α, c α * NTK.evalSingle φ W a (X α) = ∑ i, a i * NTK.projectionCoeff n φ W X c i

entries.name: NTK.projection_eq_sum_psi
entries.statement: ∀ {d n m : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (W : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (c : Fin m → ℝ), ∑ α, c α * NTK.evalSingle φ W a (X α) = ∑ i, a i * NTK.psi n φ W X c i

entries.name: NTK.projection_joint_measurable
entries.statement: ∀ {d n m : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ), Measurable φ → ∀ (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (u : Fin m → ℝ), Measurable fun p => ∑ α, u α * NTK.evalSingle φ p.1 p.2 (X α)

entries.name: NTK.projection_layer_eq_multivariate
entries.statement: ∀ (σw σb : ℝ) (n m : ℕ) (H : Fin n → Fin m → ℝ) (w : Fin n → ℝ) (b : ℝ) (t : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), inner ℝ t (WithLp.toLp 2 fun α => σb * b + σw * √(↑n)⁻¹ * ∑ j, w j * H j α) = (σb * ∑ α, t.ofLp α) * b + ∑ j, w j * (σw * √(↑n)⁻¹ * ∑ α, t.ofLp α * H j α)

entries.name: NTK.projection_layer_variance_eq_multivariate
entries.statement: ∀ (σw σb : ℝ) (n m : ℕ) (H : Fin n → Fin m → ℝ) (t : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), (σb * ∑ α, t.ofLp α) ^ 2 + ∑ j, (σw * √(↑n)⁻¹ * ∑ α, t.ofLp α * H j α) ^ 2 = t.ofLp ⬝ᵥ Matrix.mulVec (fun α β => σb ^ 2 + σw ^ 2 * (↑n)⁻¹ * ∑ j, H j α * H j β) t.ofLp

entries.name: NTK.psi
entries.statement: {d m : ℕ} → (n : ℕ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → (Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) → (Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) → (Fin m → ℝ) → Fin n → ℝ

entries.name: NTK.psi_eq_normalized_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (W : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (c : Fin m → ℝ) (i : Fin n), NTK.psi n φ W X c i = √(↑n)⁻¹ * ∑ α, c α * φ (W i ⊙ X α)

entries.name: NTK.psi_measurable
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), Measurable φ → ∀ (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (c : Fin m → ℝ) (i : Fin n), Measurable fun W => NTK.psi n φ W X c i

entries.name: NTK.psi_sq
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (W : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (c : Fin m → ℝ) (i : Fin n), NTK.psi n φ W X c i ^ 2 = (↑n)⁻¹ * ∑ α, ∑ β, c α * c β * (φ (W i ⊙ X α) * φ (W i ⊙ X β))

entries.name: NTK.reducedDomain
entries.statement: (d : ℕ) → Set (Fin d → ℝ)

entries.name: NTK.reducedKernel
entries.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℝ) → (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ

entries.name: NTK.reducedKernelCoeff
entries.statement: ℕ → ℝ

entries.name: NTK.reducedKernelCoeff_pos
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < NTK.reducedKernelCoeff n

entries.name: NTK.reducedKernel_eq_reluNTK
entries.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (x x' : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ), x ∈ NTK.ntkDomain (d + 1) → x' ∈ NTK.ntkDomain (d + 1) → (NTK.reducedKernel (fun k => x k.castSucc) fun k => x' k.castSucc) = NTK.limitingNTK NTK.reluIndicator x x'

entries.name: NTK.relu
entries.statement: ℝ → ℝ

entries.name: NTK.reluDeriv
entries.statement: ℝ → ℝ

entries.name: NTK.reluDeriv_eq_reluIndicator
entries.statement: NTK.reluDeriv = NTK.reluIndicator

entries.name: NTK.reluIndicator
entries.statement: ℝ → ℝ

entries.name: NTK.reluIndicator_eq_indicator_Ici
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → ℝ), (fun w => NTK.reluIndicator (w ⊙ x)) = {w | w ⊙ x ≥ 0}.indicator fun x => 1

entries.name: NTK.reluIndicator_mul_reluIndicator_toEuclideanCLM_diagScale
entries.statement: ∀ (Φαα Φββ : ℝ), 0 < Φαα → 0 < Φββ → ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), NTK.reluIndicator (((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM !![√Φαα, 0; 0, √Φββ]) z).ofLp 0) * NTK.reluIndicator (((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM !![√Φαα, 0; 0, √Φββ]) z).ofLp 1) = NTK.reluIndicator (z.ofLp 0) * NTK.reluIndicator (z.ofLp 1)

entries.name: NTK.reluIndicator_pos_mul
entries.statement: ∀ (c u : ℝ), 0 < c → NTK.reluIndicator (c * u) = NTK.reluIndicator u

entries.name: NTK.reluLinearizationBound
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (net : NTK.ReLUNetwork d m) (x : Fin d → ℝ), x ⊙ x ≤ 1 → ∀ (B : ℝ), 0 ≤ B → ∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → δ < 1 → 1 - δ ≤ (NTK.gaussianInit m d).real {W₀ | ∀ (W : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ), (NTK.frobeniusNorm fun i k => W i k - W₀ i k) ≤ B → |NTK.ShallowNetwork.eval net x W - NTK.linearization net.outerCoeffs x W₀ W| ≤ (2 * B ^ (4 / 3) + B * Real.log (1 / δ) ^ (1 / 4)) / ↑m ^ (1 / 6)}

entries.name: NTK.reluLinearizationBound_secondOrder
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (net : NTK.ReLUNetwork d m) (x : Fin d → ℝ), x ⊙ x ≤ 1 → ∀ (B : ℝ), 0 ≤ B → ∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → δ < 1 → 1 - δ ≤ (NTK.gaussianInit m d).real {W₀ | ∀ (W V : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ), (NTK.frobeniusNorm fun i k => W i k - W₀ i k) ≤ B → (NTK.frobeniusNorm fun i k => V i k - W₀ i k) ≤ B → |NTK.ShallowNetwork.eval net x V - (NTK.ShallowNetwork.eval net x W + NTK.linearization net.outerCoeffs x W V - NTK.ShallowNetwork.eval net x W)| ≤ (6 * B ^ (4 / 3) + 3 * B * Real.log (1 / δ) ^ (1 / 4)) / ↑m ^ (1 / 6)}

entries.name: NTK.reluNTK_closedForm
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (x x' : Fin d → ℝ), x ⊙ x = 1 → x' ⊙ x' = 1 → NTK.limitingNTK NTK.reluIndicator x x' = x ⊙ x' * (Real.pi - Real.arccos (x ⊙ x')) / (2 * Real.pi)

entries.name: NTK.reluNTK_nonneg_of_nonneg_inner
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (x x' : Fin d → ℝ), x ⊙ x = 1 → x' ⊙ x' = 1 → 0 ≤ x ⊙ x' → 0 ≤ NTK.limitingNTK NTK.reluIndicator x x'

entries.name: NTK.reluNTK_self
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → ℝ), x ⊙ x = 1 → NTK.limitingNTK NTK.reluIndicator x x = 1 / 2

entries.name: NTK.reluSignConcentration
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (x : Fin d → ℝ), 0 < x ⊙ x → ∀ (τ : ℝ), 0 < τ → ∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → δ < 1 → (NTK.gaussianInit m d).real {W₀ | ↑m * τ + √(↑m / 2 * Real.log (1 / δ)) < ↑(NTK.signAmbiguous τ x W₀).card} ≤ δ

entries.name: NTK.relu_apply
entries.statement: ∀ (u : ℝ), NTK.relu u = max u 0

entries.name: NTK.relu_eq_reluDeriv_mul
entries.statement: ∀ (z : ℝ), NTK.relu z = NTK.reluDeriv z * z

entries.name: NTK.relu_error_cs_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (x : Fin d → ℝ), x ⊙ x ≤ 1 → ∀ (W W₀ : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (B : ℝ), (NTK.frobeniusNorm fun i k => W i k - W₀ i k) ≤ B → ∀ (S : Finset (Fin m)), ∑ j ∈ S, |∑ k, (W j k - W₀ j k) * x k| ≤ √↑S.card * B

entries.name: NTK.relu_error_eq_zero_outside_badSet
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (net : NTK.ReLUNetwork d m) (x : Fin d → ℝ) (W W₀ : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (τ : ℝ), 0 < τ → ∀ j ∉ NTK.badSet τ τ x W W₀, net.outerCoeffs j * NTK.relu (∑ k, W j k * x k) - net.outerCoeffs j * NTK.reluDeriv (∑ k, W₀ j k * x k) * ∑ k, W j k * x k = 0

entries.name: NTK.relu_error_sum_le
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (net : NTK.ReLUNetwork d m) (x : Fin d → ℝ) (W W₀ : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin m)), |∑ j ∈ S, (net.outerCoeffs j * NTK.relu (∑ k, W j k * x k) - net.outerCoeffs j * NTK.reluDeriv (∑ k, W₀ j k * x k) * ∑ k, W j k * x k)| ≤ ∑ j ∈ S, |∑ k, (W j k - W₀ j k) * x k|

entries.name: NTK.relu_eval_sub_linearization_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (net : NTK.ReLUNetwork d m) (x : Fin d → ℝ) (W W₀ : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ), NTK.ShallowNetwork.eval net x W - NTK.linearization net.outerCoeffs x W₀ W = √(↑m)⁻¹ * ∑ j, (net.outerCoeffs j * NTK.relu (∑ k, W j k * x k) - net.outerCoeffs j * NTK.reluDeriv (∑ k, W₀ j k * x k) * ∑ k, W j k * x k)

entries.name: NTK.relu_linearization_error_le
entries.statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ), |NTK.relu a - NTK.reluDeriv b * a| ≤ |a - b|

entries.name: NTK.relu_mul_relu_toEuclideanCLM_diagScale
entries.statement: ∀ (Φαα Φββ : ℝ), 0 ≤ Φαα → 0 ≤ Φββ → ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), NTK.relu (((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM !![√Φαα, 0; 0, √Φββ]) z).ofLp 0) * NTK.relu (((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM !![√Φαα, 0; 0, √Φββ]) z).ofLp 1) = √(Φαα * Φββ) * (NTK.relu (z.ofLp 0) * NTK.relu (z.ofLp 1))

entries.name: NTK.relu_pos_mul
entries.statement: ∀ (c u : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → NTK.relu (c * u) = c * NTK.relu u

entries.name: NTK.rkhs_approx_by_network
entries.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ), 0 < d → ∀ h ∈ NTK.RKHSClass d, ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → δ < 1 → ∃ m net B, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ᵐ (W₀ : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) ∂NTK.gaussianInit m d, ∃ W, (NTK.frobeniusNorm fun i k => W i k - W₀ i k) ≤ B ∧ ∀ x ∈ NTK.ntkDomain d, |net.eval x W - h x| ≤ ε

entries.name: NTK.signAmbiguous
entries.statement: {d m : ℕ} → ℝ → (Fin d → ℝ) → (Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) → Finset (Fin m)

entries.name: NTK.sign_preserved_outside_badSet
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (τ : ℝ), 0 < τ → ∀ (x : Fin d → ℝ) (W W₀ : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ), ∀ j ∉ NTK.badSet τ τ x W W₀, 0 ≤ ∑ k, W j k * x k ↔ 0 ≤ ∑ k, W₀ j k * x k

entries.name: NTK.smoothLinearizationBound
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} {σ : ℝ → ℝ} {β : ℝ}, NTK.BetaSmooth σ β → ∀ (net : NTK.ShallowNetwork σ d m) (x : Fin d → ℝ), x ⊙ x ≤ 1 → ∀ (W V : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ), |net.eval x W - NTK.linearization net.outerCoeffs x V W| ≤ β / (2 * √↑m) * (NTK.frobeniusNorm fun i j => W i j - V i j) ^ 2

entries.name: NTK.stdGaussian_density_polar
entries.statement: ∀ (r phi : ℝ), ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (r * Real.cos phi) * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (r * Real.sin phi) = 1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (-(1 / 2) * r ^ 2)

entries.name: NTK.stdGaussian_inner_family
entries.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (u : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun a => WithLp.toLp 2 fun α => a ⬝ᵥ u α) (NTK.gaussianReadoutMeasure n) = ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (Matrix.of fun α β => u α ⬝ᵥ u β)

entries.name: NTK.stdGaussian_inner_pair
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u v : Fin n → ℝ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun a => !₂[a ⬝ᵥ u, a ⬝ᵥ v]) (NTK.gaussianReadoutMeasure n) = ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 !![u ⬝ᵥ u, u ⬝ᵥ v; u ⬝ᵥ v, v ⬝ᵥ v]

entries.name: NTK.sum_eq_sum_badSet
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (net : NTK.ReLUNetwork d m) (x : Fin d → ℝ) (W W₀ : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (τ : ℝ), (∀ j ∉ NTK.badSet τ τ x W W₀, net.outerCoeffs j * NTK.relu (∑ k, W j k * x k) - net.outerCoeffs j * NTK.reluDeriv (∑ k, W₀ j k * x k) * ∑ k, W j k * x k = 0) → ∑ j, (net.outerCoeffs j * NTK.relu (∑ k, W j k * x k) - net.outerCoeffs j * NTK.reluDeriv (∑ k, W₀ j k * x k) * ∑ k, W j k * x k) = ∑ j ∈ NTK.badSet τ τ x W W₀, (net.outerCoeffs j * NTK.relu (∑ k, W j k * x k) - net.outerCoeffs j * NTK.reluDeriv (∑ k, W₀ j k * x k) * ∑ k, W j k * x k)

entries.name: NTK.sum_projectionCoeff_sq_eq_bilin
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (W : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (c : Fin m → ℝ), ∑ i, NTK.projectionCoeff n φ W X c i ^ 2 = c ⬝ᵥ (NTK.empiricalCovariance n φ W X).mulVec c

entries.name: NTK.sum_psi_sq_eq_bilin
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (W : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (c : Fin m → ℝ), ∑ i, NTK.psi n φ W X c i ^ 2 = c ⬝ᵥ (NTK.empiricalCovariance n φ W X).mulVec c

entries.name: NTK.sum_sum_mul_limitingCovariance_eq_integral_sq
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ), (∀ (α : Fin m), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun w => φ (w ⊙ X α)) 2 (NTK.gaussianRowMeasure d)) → ∀ (u : Fin m → ℝ), ∑ α, ∑ β, u α * u β * NTK.limitingCovariance φ X α β = ∫ (w : Fin d → ℝ), (∑ α, u α * φ (w ⊙ X α)) ^ 2 ∂NTK.gaussianRowMeasure d

entries.name: NTK.sum_sum_mul_limitingCovariance_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ), (∀ (α : Fin m), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun w => φ (w ⊙ X α)) 2 (NTK.gaussianRowMeasure d)) → ∀ (u : Fin m → ℝ), 0 ≤ ∑ α, ∑ β, u α * u β * NTK.limitingCovariance φ X α β

entries.name: NTK.tendstoInDistribution_deepEval
entries.statement: ∀ (d m L : ℕ), 0 < L → ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous φ → ∀ (C : ℝ), 0 ≤ C → ∀ (p : ℕ), 0 < p → (∀ (x : ℝ), |φ x| ≤ C * (1 + |x| ^ p)) → ∀ (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ), MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution (fun n q => WithLp.toLp 2 fun α => √(↑n)⁻¹ * ∑ j, q.2.1 ↑j * φ (NTK.deepPreactivation d m n φ X (fun k => if h : k < L then q.1 ⟨k, h⟩ else 0) (L - 1) α j)) Filter.atTop id (fun x => (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x => MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1).prod ((MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1).prod (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1))) (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (NTK.layerCovarianceSeq 1 0 φ m (fun α β => (↑d)⁻¹ * X α ⊙ X β) L))

entries.name: NTK.tendstoInDistribution_evalVector
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ), Measurable φ → (∀ (α : Fin m), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun w => φ (w ⊙ X α)) 2 (NTK.gaussianRowMeasure d)) → MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution (fun n p => NTK.evalVector φ p.1 p.2 X) Filter.atTop id (fun n => NTK.initMeasure n d) (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (NTK.limitingCovariance φ X))

entries.name: NTK.tendstoInDistribution_projection
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ), Measurable φ → (∀ (α : Fin m), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun w => φ (w ⊙ X α)) 2 (NTK.gaussianRowMeasure d)) → ∀ (u : Fin m → ℝ), MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution (fun n p => ∑ α, u α * NTK.evalSingle φ p.1 p.2 (X α)) Filter.atTop id (fun n => NTK.initMeasure n d) (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (u ⬝ᵥ (NTK.limitingCovariance φ X).mulVec u).toNNReal)

entries.name: NTK.tendstoInDistribution_sequential_bivariate
entries.statement: ∀ (σw σb : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), Measurable φ → ∀ (K : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K)], K.PosSemidef → (∀ (α : Fin 2), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun z => φ (z.ofLp α)) 2 (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K)) → MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution (fun n p => WithLp.toLp 2 fun α => σb * p.2.2 + σw * √(↑n)⁻¹ * ∑ j, p.2.1 j * φ ((p.1 ↑j).ofLp α)) Filter.atTop id (fun n => (MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K).prod ((NTK.gaussianReadoutMeasure n).prod (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1))) (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 fun α β => σb ^ 2 + σw ^ 2 * ∫ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), φ (z.ofLp α) * φ (z.ofLp β) ∂ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K)

entries.name: NTK.tendstoInDistribution_sequential_preactivation
entries.statement: ∀ (σw σb : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), Measurable φ → ∀ (K : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K)], K.PosSemidef → (∀ (α : Fin m), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun z => φ (z.ofLp α)) 2 (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K)) → MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution (fun n p => WithLp.toLp 2 fun α => σb * p.2.2 + σw * √(↑n)⁻¹ * ∑ j, p.2.1 j * φ ((p.1 ↑j).ofLp α)) Filter.atTop id (fun n => (MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K).prod ((NTK.gaussianReadoutMeasure n).prod (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1))) (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 fun α β => σb ^ 2 + σw ^ 2 * ∫ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), φ (z.ofLp α) * φ (z.ofLp β) ∂ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K)

entries.name: NTK.tendstoInMeasure_comp_measurePreserving
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {E : Type u_3} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure β} [inst : PseudoEMetricSpace E] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] {T : α → β} {f : ℕ → β → E} {g : β → E}, MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure ν f Filter.atTop g → MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving T μ ν → (∀ (n : ℕ), Measurable (f n)) → Measurable g → MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure μ (fun n a => f n (T a)) Filter.atTop fun a => g (T a)

entries.name: NTK.tendstoInMeasure_comp_of_continuousAt
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [inst : PseudoEMetricSpace E] [inst_1 : PseudoEMetricSpace F] {f : ℕ → α → E} {y : E} {g : E → F}, (MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure μ f Filter.atTop fun x => y) → ContinuousAt g y → MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure μ (fun n a => g (f n a)) Filter.atTop fun x => g y

entries.name: NTK.tendstoInMeasure_comp_of_continuousWithinAt
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [inst : PseudoEMetricSpace E] [inst_1 : PseudoEMetricSpace F] {f : ℕ → α → E} {y : E} {g : E → F} {s : Set E}, (MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure μ f Filter.atTop fun x => y) → (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : α), f n a ∈ s) → ContinuousWithinAt g s y → MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure μ (fun n a => g (f n a)) Filter.atTop fun x => g y

entries.name: NTK.tendsto_charFun_map_deepEval
entries.statement: ∀ (d m L : ℕ), 0 < L → ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous φ → ∀ (C : ℝ), 0 ≤ C → ∀ (p : ℕ), 0 < p → (∀ (x : ℝ), |φ x| ≤ C * (1 + |x| ^ p)) → ∀ (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ) (t : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => MeasureTheory.charFun (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun q => WithLp.toLp 2 fun α => √(↑n)⁻¹ * ∑ j, q.2.1 ↑j * φ (NTK.deepPreactivation d m n φ X (fun k => if h : k < L then q.1 ⟨k, h⟩ else 0) (L - 1) α j)) ((MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x => MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1).prod ((MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1).prod (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1)))) t) Filter.atTop (nhds (MeasureTheory.charFun (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (NTK.layerCovarianceSeq 1 0 φ m (fun α β => (↑d)⁻¹ * X α ⊙ X β) L)) t))

entries.name: NTK.tendsto_charFun_map_projection
entries.statement: ∀ {d m : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (X : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ), Measurable φ → (∀ (α : Fin m), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun w => φ (w ⊙ X α)) 2 (NTK.gaussianRowMeasure d)) → ∀ (u : Fin m → ℝ) (t : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => MeasureTheory.charFun (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun p => ∑ α, u α * NTK.evalSingle φ p.1 p.2 (X α)) (NTK.initMeasure n d)) t) Filter.atTop (nhds (Complex.exp (-↑(t ^ 2 * u ⬝ᵥ (NTK.limitingCovariance φ X).mulVec u) / 2)))

entries.name: NTK.tendsto_charFun_map_projection_eq_gaussianReal

entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_3 : NormedSpace ℝ E] {V : Ω → ℝ} {O : Ω → E}, 0 ≤ V → MeasureTheory.Integrable V μ → MeasureTheory.Integrable O μ → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => V x • O x) μ → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => V x ^ 2) μ → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => V x ^ 2 • O x) μ → (fun ε => ∫ (x : Ω), O x ∂Renormalization.deform μ V ε - ∫ (x : Ω), O x ∂μ + ε • Renormalization.covarianceWith μ O V) =O[nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ici 0)] fun ε => ε ^ 2

entries.name: Renormalization.integral_eq_zero_of_odd
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_4} [inst : MeasurableSpace E] [inst_1 : Neg E] [MeasurableNeg E] (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure E) [ν.IsNegInvariant] {F : E → ℝ}, MeasureTheory.Integrable F ν → (∀ (x : E), F (-x) = -F x) → ∫ (x : E), F x ∂ν = 0

entries.name: Renormalization.integral_eq_zero_of_odd_of_aestronglyMeasurable
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_4} [inst : MeasurableSpace E] [inst_1 : Neg E] [MeasurableNeg E] (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure E) [ν.IsNegInvariant] {F : E → ℝ}, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable F ν → (∀ (x : E), F (-x) = -F x) → ∫ (x : E), F x ∂ν = 0

entries.name: Renormalization.integral_exp_neg_quadraticAction_inv_posDef
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type uI} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (K : Matrix ι ι ℝ), K.PosDef → ∫ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Real.exp (-Renormalization.quadraticAction K⁻¹ z) = √((2 * Real.pi) ^ Fintype.card ι * K.det)

entries.name: Renormalization.integral_mul_pow_gaussianReal
entries.statement: ∀ (v : NNReal) (n : ℕ), ∫ (x : ℝ), x * x ^ n ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v = ↑v * ↑n * ∫ (x : ℝ), x ^ (n - 1) ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v

entries.name: Renormalization.integral_pow_gaussianReal_even
entries.statement: ∀ (v : NNReal) (m : ℕ), ∫ (x : ℝ), x ^ (2 * m) ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v = ↑(2 * m).factorial / (2 ^ m * ↑m.factorial) * ↑v ^ m

entries.name: Renormalization.integral_pow_gaussianReal_odd
entries.statement: ∀ (v : NNReal) (m : ℕ), ∫ (x : ℝ), x ^ (2 * m + 1) ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v = 0

entries.name: Renormalization.integral_prod_multivariateGaussian_centered_eq_wick
entries.statement: ∀ {κ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype κ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq κ] {n : ℕ} (m : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ) (S : Matrix κ κ ℝ), S.PosSemidef → ∀ (index : Fin n → κ), (Renormalization.jointMoment (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian m S) fun r z => z.ofLp (index r) - m.ofLp (index r)) = Renormalization.wick (fun r q => S (index r) (index q)) Finset.univ

entries.name: Renormalization.isProbabilityMeasure_deform
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (V : Ω → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), Renormalization.Normalizable μ V ε → MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (Renormalization.deform μ V ε)

entries.name: Renormalization.iteratedDeriv_cgf_zero_eq_sum_partitions
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : Ω → ℝ) (n : ℕ), n ≠ 0 → 0 ∈ interior (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) → iteratedDeriv n (ProbabilityTheory.cgf X μ) 0 = ∑ P, P.cumulantCoefficient * ∏ B ∈ P.parts, iteratedDeriv B.card (ProbabilityTheory.mgf X μ) 0

entries.name: Renormalization.iteratedDeriv_cgf_zero_eq_sum_partitions_faaDiBruno
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : Ω → ℝ) (n : ℕ), n ≠ 0 → 0 ∈ interior (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) → iteratedDeriv n (ProbabilityTheory.cgf X μ) 0 = ∑ P, P.cumulantCoefficient * ∏ B ∈ P.parts, iteratedDeriv B.card (ProbabilityTheory.mgf X μ) 0

entries.name: Renormalization.iteratedDeriv_exp_quadratic_zero_even
entries.statement: ∀ (v : ℝ) (m : ℕ), iteratedDeriv (2 * m) (fun t => Real.exp (v * t ^ 2 / 2)) 0 = ↑(2 * m).factorial / (2 ^ m * ↑m.factorial) * v ^ m

entries.name: Renormalization.iteratedDeriv_exp_quadratic_zero_odd
entries.statement: ∀ (v : ℝ) (m : ℕ), iteratedDeriv (2 * m + 1) (fun t => Real.exp (v * t ^ 2 / 2)) 0 = 0

entries.name: Renormalization.iteratedDeriv_mgf_zero_eq_moment
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} (X : Ω → ℝ) (k : ℕ), 0 ∈ interior (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) → iteratedDeriv k (ProbabilityTheory.mgf X μ) 0 = ∫ (ω : Ω), X ω ^ k ∂μ

entries.name: Renormalization.jointCumulant
entries.statement: {Ω : Type u_1} → {ι : Type u_2} → [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] → [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → MeasureTheory.Measure Ω → (ι → Ω → ℝ) → ℝ

entries.name: Renormalization.jointCumulantMultilinearMap
entries.statement: {Ω : Type u_1} → {ι : Type u_2} → {κ : Type u_3} → [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] → {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} → [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → [inst_3 : Fintype κ] → (X : κ → Ω → ℝ) → (∀ (A : ι → κ → ℝ), Renormalization.HasFiniteJointMoments μ (Renormalization.linearCombinationFamily X A)) → MultilinearMap ℝ (fun x => κ → ℝ) ℝ

entries.name: Renormalization.jointCumulant_add
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (i : ι) (Y : Ω → ℝ), Renormalization.HasFiniteJointMoments μ X → Renormalization.HasFiniteJointMoments μ (Function.update X i Y) → Renormalization.jointCumulant μ (Function.update X i (X i + Y)) = Renormalization.jointCumulant μ X + Renormalization.jointCumulant μ (Function.update X i Y)

entries.name: Renormalization.jointCumulant_coordinates_eq_zero_of_odd
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type uI} [Finite ι] (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) [ν.IsNegInvariant] (n : ℕ), Odd n → ∀ (index : Fin n → ι), (Renormalization.HasFiniteJointMoments ν fun r z => z.ofLp (index r)) → (Renormalization.jointCumulant ν fun r z => z.ofLp (index r)) = 0

entries.name: Renormalization.jointCumulant_eq_zero_of_diagonal_linearCombination
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (X : ι → Ω → ℝ), (∀ (A : ι → ι → ℝ), Renormalization.HasFiniteJointMoments μ (Renormalization.linearCombinationFamily X A)) → (∀ (a : ι → ℝ), (Renormalization.jointCumulant μ fun x ω => ∑ j, a j * X j ω) = 0) → Renormalization.jointCumulant μ X = 0

entries.name: Renormalization.jointCumulant_eq_zero_of_indepFun_split
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (A : Finset ι), A.Nonempty → (Finset.univ \ A).Nonempty → Renormalization.HasFiniteJointMoments μ X → (∀ (i : ι), Measurable (X i)) → Renormalization.IndepAcross μ X A → Renormalization.jointCumulant μ X = 0

entries.name: Renormalization.jointCumulant_four_of_centered
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} (X : Fin 4 → Ω → ℝ), (∀ (i : Fin 4), ∫ (ω : Ω), X i ω ∂μ = 0) → Renormalization.jointCumulant μ X = ∫ (ω : Ω), X 0 ω * X 1 ω * X 2 ω * X 3 ω ∂μ - (∫ (ω : Ω), X 0 ω * X 1 ω ∂μ) * ∫ (ω : Ω), X 2 ω * X 3 ω ∂μ - (∫ (ω : Ω), X 0 ω * X 2 ω ∂μ) * ∫ (ω : Ω), X 1 ω * X 3 ω ∂μ - (∫ (ω : Ω), X 0 ω * X 3 ω ∂μ) * ∫ (ω : Ω), X 1 ω * X 2 ω ∂μ

entries.name: Renormalization.jointCumulant_four_of_centered_combinatorics
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} (X : Fin 4 → Ω → ℝ), (∀ (i : Fin 4), ∫ (ω : Ω), X i ω ∂μ = 0) → Finpartition.cumulantTransform (Renormalization.blockMoment μ X) Finset.univ = Renormalization.blockMoment μ X {0, 1, 2, 3} - Renormalization.blockMoment μ X {0, 1} * Renormalization.blockMoment μ X {2, 3} - Renormalization.blockMoment μ X {0, 2} * Renormalization.blockMoment μ X {1, 3} - Renormalization.blockMoment μ X {0, 3} * Renormalization.blockMoment μ X {1, 2}

entries.name: Renormalization.jointCumulant_one
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} (X : Fin 1 → Ω → ℝ), Renormalization.jointCumulant μ X = ∫ (ω : Ω), X 0 ω ∂μ

entries.name: Renormalization.jointCumulant_perm
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} {κ : Type u_3} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_3 : Fintype κ] [inst_4 : DecidableEq κ] (e : ι ≃ κ) (X : ι → Ω → ℝ), (Renormalization.jointCumulant μ fun j => X (e.symm j)) = Renormalization.jointCumulant μ X

entries.name: Renormalization.jointCumulant_six_eq_moments
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type uΩ} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : Fin 6 → Ω → ℝ), (∀ (B : Finset (Fin 6)), Odd B.card → Renormalization.blockMoment μ X B = 0) → Renormalization.jointCumulant μ X = Renormalization.jointMoment μ X - Renormalization.sixPointFourTwoMomentSum μ X + 2 * Renormalization.sixPointPairingMomentSum μ X

entries.name: Renormalization.jointCumulant_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (i : ι) (c : ℝ), Renormalization.jointCumulant μ (Function.update X i (c • X i)) = c * Renormalization.jointCumulant μ X

entries.name: Renormalization.jointCumulant_two
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} (X : Fin 2 → Ω → ℝ), Renormalization.jointCumulant μ X = ∫ (ω : Ω), X 0 ω * X 1 ω ∂μ - (∫ (ω : Ω), X 0 ω ∂μ) * ∫ (ω : Ω), X 1 ω ∂μ

entries.name: Renormalization.jointCumulant_two_eq_covariance
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : Fin 2 → Ω → ℝ), MeasureTheory.MemLp (X 0) 2 μ → MeasureTheory.MemLp (X 1) 2 μ → Renormalization.jointCumulant μ X = ProbabilityTheory.covariance (X 0) (X 1) μ

entries.name: Renormalization.jointCumulant_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} (X : Fin 0 → Ω → ℝ), Renormalization.jointCumulant μ X = 0

entries.name: Renormalization.jointMoment
entries.statement: {Ω : Type u_1} → {ι : Type u_2} → [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] → [Fintype ι] → MeasureTheory.Measure Ω → (ι → Ω → ℝ) → ℝ

entries.name: Renormalization.jointMoment_congr_ae
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] {X Y : ι → Ω → ℝ}, (∀ (i : ι), X i =ᵐ[μ] Y i) → Renormalization.jointMoment μ X = Renormalization.jointMoment μ Y

entries.name: Renormalization.jointMoment_coordinates_eq_zero_of_odd
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type uI} [Finite ι] (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) [ν.IsNegInvariant] (n : ℕ), Odd n → ∀ (index : Fin n → ι), MeasureTheory.Integrable (Renormalization.coordinateMonomial index) ν → (Renormalization.jointMoment ν fun r z => z.ofLp (index r)) = 0

entries.name: Renormalization.jointMoment_eq_blockMoment_univ
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (X : ι → Ω → ℝ), Renormalization.jointMoment μ X = Renormalization.blockMoment μ X Finset.univ

entries.name: Renormalization.jointMoment_eq_sum_partition_jointCumulant
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : ι → Ω → ℝ), Renormalization.jointMoment μ X = ∑ P, ∏ B ∈ P.parts, Renormalization.jointCumulant μ fun i => X ↑i

entries.name: Renormalization.jointMoment_one
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} (X : Fin 1 → Ω → ℝ), Renormalization.jointMoment μ X = ∫ (ω : Ω), X 0 ω ∂μ

entries.name: Renormalization.jointMoment_perm
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} {κ : Type u_3} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : Fintype κ] (e : ι ≃ κ) (X : ι → Ω → ℝ), (Renormalization.jointMoment μ fun j => X (e.symm j)) = Renormalization.jointMoment μ X

entries.name: Renormalization.jointMoment_six_eq_connected_decomposition
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type uΩ} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : Fin 6 → Ω → ℝ), (∀ (B : Finset (Fin 6)), Odd B.card → Renormalization.blockCumulant μ X B = 0) → Renormalization.jointMoment μ X = Renormalization.jointCumulant μ X + Renormalization.sixPointFourTwoCumulantSum μ X + Renormalization.sixPointPairingCumulantSum μ X

entries.name: Renormalization.jointMoment_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : Fin 0 → Ω → ℝ), Renormalization.jointMoment μ X = 1

entries.name: Renormalization.mapEquiv_isPairing_iff

entries.name: Renormalization.map_multivariateGaussian_eq_pi_of_orthogonal_diagonalization
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type uI} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (K O : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (v : ι → NNReal), O.transpose * O = 1 → (O * K * O.transpose = Matrix.diagonal fun i => ↑(v i)) → MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun z => O.mulVec ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℝ) z)) (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 K) = MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun i => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (v i)

entries.name: Renormalization.moment_eq_iteratedDeriv_mgf
entries.statement: ∀ (v : NNReal) (k : ℕ), ∫ (x : ℝ), x ^ k ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v = iteratedDeriv k (fun t => Real.exp (↑v * t ^ 2 / 2)) 0

entries.name: Renormalization.mul_sub_linear_isBigO
entries.statement: ∀ {l : Filter ℝ}, Filter.Tendsto (fun ε => ε) l (nhds 0) → ∀ {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b c d : ℝ}, ((fun ε => f ε - (a + ε * b)) =O[l] fun ε => ε ^ 2) → ((fun ε => g ε - (c + ε * d)) =O[l] fun ε => ε ^ 2) → (fun ε => f ε * g ε - (a * c + ε * (b * c + a * d))) =O[l] fun ε => ε ^ 2

entries.name: Renormalization.multilinearMap_apply_eq_zero_of_diagonal_eq_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_2} {E : Type u_4} [Finite ι] [inst : AddCommMonoid E] [inst_1 : Module ℝ E] (M : MultilinearMap ℝ (fun x => E) ℝ), (∀ (e : Equiv.Perm ι) (A : ι → E), (M fun i => A ((Equiv.symm e) i)) = M A) → (∀ (a : E), (M fun x => a) = 0) → ∀ (v : ι → E), M v = 0

entries.name: Renormalization.multilinearMap_eq_zero_on_basis_of_diagonal_eq_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_2} [Finite ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] (M : MultilinearMap ℝ (fun x => ι → ℝ) ℝ), (∀ (e : Equiv.Perm ι) (A : ι → ι → ℝ), (M fun i => A ((Equiv.symm e) i)) = M A) → (∀ (a : ι → ℝ), (M fun x => a) = 0) → (M fun i j => if i = j then 1 else 0) = 0

entries.name: Renormalization.multivariateGaussian_diagonal_eq_map_pi_gaussianReal
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type uI} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (v : ι → NNReal), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (⇑(EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℝ)) (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (Matrix.diagonal fun i => ↑(v i))) = MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun i => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (v i)

entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] {V : Ω → ℝ}, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable V μ → 0 ≤ V → ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 ≤ ε → Renormalization.Normalizable μ V ε

entries.name: Renormalization.not_indepAcross_of_jointCumulant_ne_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type uΩ} {ι : Type uI} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (A : Finset ι), A.Nonempty → (Finset.univ \ A).Nonempty → Renormalization.HasFiniteJointMoments μ X → (∀ (i : ι), Measurable (X i)) → Renormalization.jointCumulant μ X ≠ 0 → ¬Renormalization.IndepAcross μ X A

entries.statement: {α : Type u_2} → {β : Type u_3} → [inst : DecidableEq α] → [inst_1 : DecidableEq β] → (e : α ≃ β) → (s : Finset α) → Finpartition.Pairing s ≃ Finpartition.Pairing (Finset.map e.toEmbedding s)

entries.name: Renormalization.pairingSum_map
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq β] {R : Type u_4} [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] (e : α ≃ β) (f : Finset β → R) (s : Finset α), Finpartition.pairingSum f (Finset.map e.toEmbedding s) = Finpartition.pairingSum (fun B => f (Finset.map e.toEmbedding B)) s

entries.name: Renormalization.partitionFunction_sub_linear_isBigO
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {V : Ω → ℝ}, 0 ≤ V → MeasureTheory.Integrable V μ → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => V x ^ 2) μ → (fun ε => Renormalization.partitionFunction μ V ε - 1 + ε * ∫ (x : Ω), V x ∂μ) =O[nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ici 0)] fun ε => ε ^ 2

entries.statement: ∀ {K : ℕ} {c : ℝ} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel (Fin K) ℝ} {Ω : Type u_1} {A : ℕ → Ω → Fin K} {R : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {n : ℕ} {ω : Ω} [inst : Nonempty (Fin K)], 0 ≤ c → ∫ (x : ℝ), id x ∂ν (Bandits.bestArm ν) ≤ Learning.empMean A R (Bandits.bestArm ν) n ω + Bandits.UCB.ucbWidth A c (Bandits.bestArm ν) n ω → Learning.empMean A R (A n ω) n ω - Bandits.UCB.ucbWidth A c (A n ω) n ω ≤ ∫ (x : ℝ), id x ∂ν (A n ω) → Learning.empMean A R (Bandits.bestArm ν) n ω + Bandits.UCB.ucbWidth A c (Bandits.bestArm ν) n ω ≤ Learning.empMean A R (A n ω) n ω + Bandits.UCB.ucbWidth A c (A n ω) n ω → 0 < Bandits.gap ν (A n ω) → 0 < Learning.pullCount A (A n ω) n ω → ↑(Learning.pullCount A (A n ω) n ω) ≤ 8 * c * Real.log (↑n + 1) / Bandits.gap ν (A n ω) ^ 2

entries.name: Bandits.UCB.regret_le
entries.statement: ∀ {K : ℕ} [inst : NeZero K] {c : ℝ} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel (Fin K) ℝ} [inst_1 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {O : ℕ → Ω → Unit} {A : ℕ → Ω → Fin K} {R : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {σ2 : NNReal}, Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq O A R (Bandits.ucbAlgorithm K (c * ↑σ2)) (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → (∀ (a : Fin K), ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF (fun x => x - ∫ (x : ℝ), id x ∂ν a) σ2 (ν a)) → σ2 ≠ 0 → 0 < c → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∫ (x : Ω), Bandits.regret ν A n x ∂P ≤ ∑ a, (8 * c * ↑σ2 * Real.log (↑n + 1) / Bandits.gap ν a + Bandits.gap ν a * (2 + 2 * Bandits.UCB.constSum c n))

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.finitePreactivation
entries.statement: {P : Type uP} → {ι : Type uι} → {κ : Type uκ} → [Fintype ι] → NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer ι κ → NeuralNetwork.FiniteBoundary P → ℕ → (ι × P → ℝ) → κ × P → ℝ

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.finitePreactivation_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {P : Type uP} {ι : Type uι} {κ : Type uκ} [inst : Fintype ι] (L : NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer ι κ) (B : NeuralNetwork.FiniteBoundary P) (k : ℕ) (x : ι × P → ℝ) (o : κ) (p : P), L.finitePreactivation B k x (o, p) = L.bias o + ∑ i, ∑ dc, ∑ dd, L.weight o i ↑dc ↑dd * x (i, B.shift p ↑dc ↑dd)

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.ofOffsetTiedDense
entries.statement: {ι : Type u} → {κ : Type v} → NeuralNetwork.DenseLayer ι κ → NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer ι κ

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.paramCount
entries.statement: {ι : Type u} → {κ : Type v} → [Fintype ι] → [Fintype κ] → NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer ι κ → ℕ → ℕ

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.paramCount_le_unrestrictedGlobalDense
entries.statement: ∀ {P : Type uP} {ι : Type uι} {κ : Type uκ} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] [inst_2 : Fintype P] (L : NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer ι κ) (k : ℕ), 0 < Fintype.card P → (2 * k + 1) ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card P → L.paramCount k ≤ NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.unrestrictedGlobalDenseParamCount

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.preactivation
entries.statement: {ι : Type u} → {κ : Type v} → [Fintype ι] → NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer ι κ → ℕ → (ι → ℤ → ℤ → ℝ) → κ → ℤ → ℤ → ℝ

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.preactivation_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u} {κ : Type v} [inst : Fintype ι] (L : NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer ι κ) (k : ℕ) (x : ι → ℤ → ℤ → ℝ) (o : κ) (c d : ℤ), L.preactivation k x o c d = L.bias o + ∑ i, ∑ dc ∈ NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.window k, ∑ dd ∈ NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.window k, L.weight o i dc dd * x i (c + dc) (d + dd)

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.preactivation_eq_toLocalDenseLayer
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u} {κ : Type v} [inst : Fintype ι] (L : NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer ι κ) (k : ℕ) (x : ι → ℤ → ℤ → ℝ) (o : κ) (c d : ℤ), L.preactivation k x o c d = (L.toLocalDenseLayer k).preactivation (NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.extractPatch k x c d) o

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.preactivation_ofOffsetTiedDense
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u} {κ : Type v} [inst : Fintype ι] (L : NeuralNetwork.DenseLayer ι κ) (k : ℕ) (x : ι → ℤ → ℤ → ℝ) (o : κ) (c d : ℤ), (NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.ofOffsetTiedDense L).preactivation k x o c d = L.bias o + ∑ i, ∑ dc ∈ NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.window k, ∑ dd ∈ NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.window k, L.weight o i * x i (c + dc) (d + dd)

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.preactivation_shift
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u} {κ : Type v} [inst : Fintype ι] (L : NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer ι κ) (k : ℕ) (x : ι → ℤ → ℤ → ℝ) (a b : ℤ), L.preactivation k (NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.shift a b x) = NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.shift a b (L.preactivation k x)

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.preactivation_toGlobalDenseLayer
entries.statement: ∀ {P : Type uP} {ι : Type uι} {κ : Type uκ} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype P] [inst_2 : DecidableEq P] (L : NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer ι κ) (B : NeuralNetwork.FiniteBoundary P) (k : ℕ) (x : ι × P → ℝ), (L.toGlobalDenseLayer B k).preactivation x = L.finitePreactivation B k x

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.shift
entries.statement: {ι : Type u} → ℤ → ℤ → (ι → ℤ → ℤ → ℝ) → ι → ℤ → ℤ → ℝ

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.sum_over_prod
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Fintype β] [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid R] (f : α × β → R), ∑ p, f p = ∑ a, ∑ b, f (a, b)

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.toGlobalDenseLayer
entries.statement: {P : Type uP} → {ι : Type uι} → {κ : Type uκ} → [DecidableEq P] → NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer ι κ → NeuralNetwork.FiniteBoundary P → ℕ → NeuralNetwork.DenseLayer (ι × P) (κ × P)

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.toGlobalDenseLayer_bias
entries.statement: ∀ {P : Type uP} {ι : Type uι} {κ : Type uκ} [inst : DecidableEq P] (L : NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer ι κ) (B : NeuralNetwork.FiniteBoundary P) (k : ℕ) (o : κ) (p : P), (L.toGlobalDenseLayer B k).bias (o, p) = L.bias o

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.toGlobalDenseLayer_paramCount
entries.statement: ∀ {P : Type uP} {ι : Type uι} {κ : Type uκ} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] [inst_2 : Fintype P] [inst_3 : DecidableEq P] (L : NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer ι κ) (B : NeuralNetwork.FiniteBoundary P) (k : ℕ), (L.toGlobalDenseLayer B k).paramCount = NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.unrestrictedGlobalDenseParamCount

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.toGlobalDenseLayer_weight
entries.statement: ∀ {P : Type uP} {ι : Type uι} {κ : Type uκ} [inst : DecidableEq P] (L : NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer ι κ) (B : NeuralNetwork.FiniteBoundary P) (k : ℕ) (o : κ) (p : P) (i : ι) (q : P), (L.toGlobalDenseLayer B k).weight (o, p) (i, q) = ∑ r, if B.shift p ↑r.1 ↑r.2 = q then L.weight o i ↑r.1 ↑r.2 else 0

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.toGlobalDenseLayer_weight_eq_zero_of_not_reachable
entries.statement: ∀ {P : Type uP} {ι : Type uι} {κ : Type uκ} [inst : DecidableEq P] (L : NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer ι κ) (B : NeuralNetwork.FiniteBoundary P) (k : ℕ) (o : κ) (p : P) (i : ι) (q : P), (∀ (dc dd : NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.WindowIndex k), B.shift p ↑dc ↑dd ≠ q) → (L.toGlobalDenseLayer B k).weight (o, p) (i, q) = 0

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.correlatorAmplitude_append

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.covariance_batchOutputLaw
entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type uA} {dIn dOut : ℕ} (S : NeuralNetwork.MLPShape dIn dOut) (Cw : NNReal) (D : A → Fin dIn → ℝ) (a b : A) (i j : Fin dOut), 0 < dIn → (∀ n ∈ S.hiddenWidths, 0 < n) → ProbabilityTheory.covariance (fun z => z a i) (fun z => z b j) (S.deepLinearBatchLaw Cw D) = if i = j then ↑Cw ^ S.depth * NeuralNetwork.normalizedGram D a b else 0

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.covariance_batchOutputLaw_closedForm
entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type uA} {dIn dOut : ℕ} (S : NeuralNetwork.MLPShape dIn dOut) (Cw : NNReal) (D : A → Fin dIn → ℝ) (a b : A) (i j : Fin dOut), 0 < dIn → (∀ n ∈ S.hiddenWidths, 0 < n) → ∫ (z : A → Fin dOut → ℝ), z a i * z b j ∂S.deepLinearBatchLaw Cw D = if i = j then ↑Cw ^ S.depth * NeuralNetwork.normalizedGram D a b else 0

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.covariance_batchOutputLaw_eq_integral_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type uA} {dIn dOut : ℕ} (S : NeuralNetwork.MLPShape dIn dOut) (Cw : NNReal) (D : A → Fin dIn → ℝ) (a b : A) (i j : Fin dOut), 0 < dIn → (∀ n ∈ S.hiddenWidths, 0 < n) → ProbabilityTheory.covariance (fun z => z a i) (fun z => z b j) (S.deepLinearBatchLaw Cw D) = ∫ (z : A → Fin dOut → ℝ), z a i * z b j ∂S.deepLinearBatchLaw Cw D

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.covariance_sq_coordinates
entries.statement: ∀ {dIn dOut : ℕ} (S : NeuralNetwork.MLPShape dIn dOut) (Cw : NNReal) (x : Fin dIn → ℝ) (j k : Fin dOut), j ≠ k → 0 < dIn → (∀ n ∈ S.hiddenWidths, 0 < n) → ProbabilityTheory.covariance (fun z => z j ^ 2) (fun z => z k ^ 2) (S.deepLinearOutputLaw Cw x) = (NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.hiddenWidthCorrection 2 S.hiddenWidths - 1) * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.twoPointAmplitude Cw (NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy x) S.hiddenWidths ^ 2

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.deepLinearBatchLaw_isNegInvariant
entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type uA} {dIn dOut : ℕ} (S : NeuralNetwork.MLPShape dIn dOut) (Cw : NNReal) (D : A → Fin dIn → ℝ), (S.deepLinearBatchLaw Cw D).IsNegInvariant

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.deepLinearOutputLaw_isNegInvariant

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.equalWidthCorrection_sub_linear_isBigO
entries.statement: ∀ (m depth : ℕ), (fun n => NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.widthMomentFactor m n ^ depth - (1 + ↑depth * ↑m * ↑(m - 1) / ↑n)) =O[Filter.atTop] fun n => (↑n)⁻¹ ^ 2

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.eval_negLastLayer
entries.statement: ∀ {m n : ℕ} (S : NeuralNetwork.MLPShape m n) (θ : S.Params) (x : Fin m → ℝ), S.eval (NeuralNetwork.linear 1) (NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.negLastLayer S θ) x = -S.eval (NeuralNetwork.linear 1) θ x

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.exp_six_sub_three_exp_two_add_two_isBigO
entries.statement: (fun r => Real.exp (6 * r) - 3 * Real.exp (2 * r) + 2 - 12 * r ^ 2) =O[nhds 0] fun r => r ^ 3

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.exp_two_sub_linear_isBigO
entries.statement: (fun r => Real.exp (2 * r) - 1 - 2 * r) =O[nhds 0] fun r => r ^ 2

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.firstLayerOutputLaw_eq_pi_gaussianReal
entries.statement: ∀ {dIn dOut : ℕ} (Cw : NNReal) (x : Fin dIn → ℝ), 0 < dIn → NeuralNetwork.MLPShape.output.deepLinearOutputLaw Cw x = MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x_1 => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (Cw * NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergyNNReal x)

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.fourPointAmplitude_eq
entries.statement: ∀ (Cw : NNReal) (q : ℝ) (widths : List ℕ), NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.correlatorAmplitude Cw q 2 widths = NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.hiddenWidthCorrection 2 widths * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.twoPointAmplitude Cw q widths ^ 2

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.integral_coordinate_pow_outputLaw_even
entries.statement: ∀ {dIn dOut : ℕ} (S : NeuralNetwork.MLPShape dIn dOut) (Cw : NNReal) (x : Fin dIn → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (j : Fin dOut), 0 < dIn → (∀ n ∈ S.hiddenWidths, 0 < n) → ∫ (z : Fin dOut → ℝ), z j ^ (2 * m) ∂S.deepLinearOutputLaw Cw x = NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.gaussianEvenCoeff m * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.correlatorAmplitude Cw (NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy x) m S.hiddenWidths

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.integral_mul_batchOutputLaw
entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type uA} {dIn dOut : ℕ} (S : NeuralNetwork.MLPShape dIn dOut) (Cw : NNReal) (D : A → Fin dIn → ℝ) (a b : A) (i j : Fin dOut), 0 < dIn → (∀ n ∈ S.hiddenWidths, 0 < n) → ∫ (z : A → Fin dOut → ℝ), z a i * z b j ∂S.deepLinearBatchLaw Cw D = if i = j then ↑Cw ^ S.depth * NeuralNetwork.normalizedGram D a b else 0

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.integral_normalizedEnergy_pow_oneLayerOutputLaw_eq_scaled_stdGaussian
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type uI} {κ : Type uJ} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] (Cw : NNReal) (x : ι → ℝ) (m : ℕ), ∫ (z : κ → ℝ), NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy z ^ m ∂NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.oneLayerOutputLaw Cw x = (↑Cw * NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy x) ^ m * ∫ (g : Fin (Fintype.card κ) → ℝ), NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy g ^ m ∂NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.standardGaussianVectorLaw (Fintype.card κ)

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.integral_normalizedEnergy_pow_randomLayerKernel
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type uI} {κ : Type uJ} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] (Cw : NNReal) (x : ι → ℝ) (m : ℕ), 0 < Fintype.card κ → ∫ (z : κ → ℝ), NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy z ^ m ∂NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.oneLayerOutputLaw Cw x = (↑Cw * NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy x) ^ m * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.widthMomentFactor m (Fintype.card κ)

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.integral_normalizedEnergy_pow_stdGaussian
entries.statement: ∀ (m n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∫ (g : Fin n → ℝ), NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy g ^ m ∂NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.standardGaussianVectorLaw n = NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.widthMomentFactor m n

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.integral_normalizedSumSq_pow_stdGaussian
entries.statement: ∀ (m n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∫ (g : Fin n → ℝ), ((↑n)⁻¹ * ∑ i, g i ^ 2) ^ m ∂NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.standardGaussianVectorLaw n = NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.widthMomentFactor m n

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.integral_sumSq_pow_stdGaussian
entries.statement: ∀ (m n : ℕ), ∫ (g : Fin n → ℝ), (∑ i, g i ^ 2) ^ m ∂NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.standardGaussianVectorLaw n = ∏ s ∈ Finset.range m, (↑n + 2 * ↑s)

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.jointCumulant_four_outputLaw
entries.statement: ∀ {dIn dOut : ℕ} (S : NeuralNetwork.MLPShape dIn dOut) (Cw : NNReal) (x : Fin dIn → ℝ) (a : Fin 4 → Fin dOut), 0 < dIn → (∀ n ∈ S.hiddenWidths, 0 < n) → (Renormalization.jointCumulant (S.deepLinearOutputLaw Cw x) fun r z => z (a r)) = NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.pairingTensor a * (NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.hiddenWidthCorrection 2 S.hiddenWidths - 1) * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.twoPointAmplitude Cw (NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy x) S.hiddenWidths ^ 2

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.jointMoment_outputLaw_even
entries.statement: ∀ {dIn dOut : ℕ} (S : NeuralNetwork.MLPShape dIn dOut) (Cw : NNReal) (x : Fin dIn → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (a : Fin (2 * m) → Fin dOut), 0 < dIn → (∀ n ∈ S.hiddenWidths, 0 < n) → ∫ (z : Fin dOut → ℝ), ∏ r, z (a r) ∂S.deepLinearOutputLaw Cw x = NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.pairingTensor a * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.correlatorAmplitude Cw (NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy x) m S.hiddenWidths

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.jointMoment_outputLaw_odd
entries.statement: ∀ {dIn dOut : ℕ} (S : NeuralNetwork.MLPShape dIn dOut) (Cw : NNReal) (x : Fin dIn → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (a : Fin (2 * m + 1) → Fin dOut), 0 < dIn → (∀ n ∈ S.hiddenWidths, 0 < n) → ∫ (z : Fin dOut → ℝ), ∏ r, z (a r) ∂S.deepLinearOutputLaw Cw x = 0

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.map_batchPreactivation
entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type uA} {ι : Type uI} {κ : Type uJ} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] [inst_2 : Fintype A] [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] (Cw : NNReal) (x : A → ι → ℝ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun q j => NeuralNetwork.batchToEuclidean (NeuralNetwork.batchPreactivation q x) j) (NeuralNetwork.layerGaussianInit (NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.hyperparams Cw) ι κ) = MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x_1 => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 fun a b => ↑Cw * NeuralNetwork.normalizedGram x a b

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.sixPointAmplitude_eq

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.sixthCumulantAmplitude_eq
entries.statement: ∀ (Cw : NNReal) (q : ℝ) (widths : List ℕ), NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.correlatorAmplitude Cw q 3 widths - 3 * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.hiddenWidthCorrection 2 widths * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.twoPointAmplitude Cw q widths ^ 3 + 2 * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.twoPointAmplitude Cw q widths ^ 3 = (NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.hiddenWidthCorrection 3 widths - 3 * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.hiddenWidthCorrection 2 widths + 2) * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.twoPointAmplitude Cw q widths ^ 3

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.tendsto_correlatorAmplitude_fixedWidth_atTop

entries.statement: ∀ (Cw q : ℝ), 1 < Cw → 0 < q → Filter.Tendsto (fun L => Cw ^ L * q) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

entries.statement: ∀ (Cw q : ℝ), 0 ≤ Cw → Cw < 1 → Filter.Tendsto (fun L => Cw ^ L * q) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.tendsto_equalWidthCorrection_doubleScaling
entries.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (L : ℕ → ℕ) (r : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto L Filter.atTop Filter.atTop → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(L n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds r) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.equalWidthCorrection m n (L n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (Real.exp (↑m * ↑(m - 1) * r)))

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.tendsto_equalWidth_correlatorAmplitude
entries.statement: ∀ (m depth : ℕ) (G2 : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun width => NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.equalWidthCorrection m width depth * G2 ^ m) Filter.atTop (nhds (G2 ^ m))

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.tendsto_fourthCumulantAmplitude_doubleScaling
entries.statement: ∀ (L : ℕ → ℕ) (r q : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto L Filter.atTop Filter.atTop → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(L n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds r) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.equalWidthCorrection 2 n (L n) - 1) * q ^ 2) Filter.atTop (nhds ((Real.exp (2 * r) - 1) * q ^ 2))

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.tendsto_outputLaw_fixedDepth_atTop
entries.statement: ∀ (dIn dOut hiddenDepth : ℕ) (Cw : NNReal) (x : Fin dIn → ℝ), 0 < dIn → Filter.Tendsto (fun width => (NeuralNetwork.MLPShape.constantHiddenShape dIn dOut width hiddenDepth).deepLinearOutputProbabilityMeasure Cw x) Filter.atTop (nhds (NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.iidGaussianProbabilityMeasure dOut (Cw ^ (hiddenDepth + 1) * NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergyNNReal x)))

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.tendsto_sixthCumulantAmplitude_doubleScaling
entries.statement: ∀ (L : ℕ → ℕ) (r q : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto L Filter.atTop Filter.atTop → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(L n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds r) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.equalWidthCorrection 3 n (L n) - 3 * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.equalWidthCorrection 2 n (L n) + 2) * q ^ 3) Filter.atTop (nhds ((Real.exp (6 * r) - 3 * Real.exp (2 * r) + 2) * q ^ 3))

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.twoPointAmplitude
entries.statement: NNReal → ℝ → List ℕ → ℝ

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.variance_normalizedEnergy
entries.statement: ∀ {dIn dOut : ℕ} (S : NeuralNetwork.MLPShape dIn dOut) (Cw : NNReal) (x : Fin dIn → ℝ), 0 < dIn → 0 < dOut → (∀ n ∈ S.hiddenWidths, 0 < n) → ProbabilityTheory.variance NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy (S.deepLinearOutputLaw Cw x) = (NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.hiddenWidthCorrection 2 S.hiddenWidths * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.widthMomentFactor 2 dOut - 1) * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.twoPointAmplitude Cw (NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy x) S.hiddenWidths ^ 2

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.variance_normalizedEnergy_equalWidth
entries.statement: ∀ (dIn width hiddenDepth : ℕ) (Cw : NNReal) (x : Fin dIn → ℝ), 0 < dIn → 0 < width → ProbabilityTheory.variance NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy ((NeuralNetwork.MLPShape.constantHiddenShape dIn width width hiddenDepth).deepLinearOutputLaw Cw x) = ((1 + 2 / ↑width) ^ (hiddenDepth + 1) - 1) * (↑Cw ^ (hiddenDepth + 1) * NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy x) ^ 2

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.widthMomentFactor_one
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.widthMomentFactor 1 n = 1

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.widthMomentFactor_sub_linear_isBigO
entries.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ), (fun n => NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.widthMomentFactor m n - (1 + ↑m * ↑(m - 1) / ↑n)) =O[Filter.atTop] fun n => (↑n)⁻¹ ^ 2

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.widthMomentFactor_three
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.widthMomentFactor 3 n = (1 + 2 / ↑n) * (1 + 4 / ↑n)

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.widthMomentFactor_two
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.widthMomentFactor 2 n = 1 + 2 / ↑n

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.widthMomentFactor_zero

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.width_depth_limits_do_not_commute

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.IIDScalarInitialization.berryEsseen_normalizedPreactivation
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type uΩ} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (I : NeuralNetwork.IIDScalarInitialization Ω P), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => |I.weight 0 ω| ^ 3) P → ∃ C, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (z : ℝ), |P.real {ω | I.normalizedPreactivation n ω ≤ z} - (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1).real (Set.Iic z)| ≤ (C * ∫ (ω : Ω), |I.weight 0 ω| ^ 3 ∂P) / √↑n

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.IIDScalarInitialization.fourthMoment_difference_eq_div_width
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type uΩ} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {Ω' : Type uΩ'} [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace Ω'] {P' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω'} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P'] (I : NeuralNetwork.IIDScalarInitialization Ω P) (J : NeuralNetwork.IIDScalarInitialization Ω' P'), MeasureTheory.MemLp (I.weight 0) 4 P → MeasureTheory.MemLp (J.weight 0) 4 P' → ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∫ (ω : Ω), I.normalizedPreactivation n ω ^ 4 ∂P - ∫ (ω : Ω'), J.normalizedPreactivation n ω ^ 4 ∂P' = (∫ (ω : Ω), I.weight 0 ω ^ 4 ∂P - ∫ (ω : Ω'), J.weight 0 ω ^ 4 ∂P') / ↑n

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.IIDScalarInitialization.fourthMoment_normalizedPreactivation
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type uΩ} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (I : NeuralNetwork.IIDScalarInitialization Ω P), MeasureTheory.MemLp (I.weight 0) 4 P → ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∫ (ω : Ω), I.normalizedPreactivation n ω ^ 4 ∂P = 3 + (∫ (ω : Ω), I.weight 0 ω ^ 4 ∂P - 3) / ↑n

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.IIDScalarInitialization.normalizedPreactivation
entries.statement: {Ω : Type uΩ} → [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] → {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} → NeuralNetwork.IIDScalarInitialization Ω P → ℕ → Ω → ℝ

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.IIDScalarInitialization.same_limit_of_matching_first_two_moments
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type uΩ} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {Ω' : Type uΩ'} [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace Ω'] {P' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω'} [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] [inst_3 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P'] (I : NeuralNetwork.IIDScalarInitialization Ω P) (J : NeuralNetwork.IIDScalarInitialization Ω' P') {ΩG : Type uΩG} [inst_4 : MeasurableSpace ΩG] {PG : MeasureTheory.Measure ΩG} [inst_5 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure PG] {Z : ΩG → ℝ}, ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw Z (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1) PG → MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution I.normalizedPreactivation Filter.atTop Z (fun x => P) PG ∧ MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution J.normalizedPreactivation Filter.atTop Z (fun x => P') PG

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.IIDScalarInitialization.tendstoInDistribution_normalizedPreactivation
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type uΩ} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (I : NeuralNetwork.IIDScalarInitialization Ω P) {ΩG : Type uΩG} [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace ΩG] {PG : MeasureTheory.Measure ΩG} [inst_3 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure PG] {Z : ΩG → ℝ}, ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw Z (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1) PG → MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution I.normalizedPreactivation Filter.atTop Z (fun x => P) PG

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.IIDScalarInitialization.tendstoInDistribution_weightedPreactivation
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type uΩ} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (I : NeuralNetwork.IIDScalarInitialization Ω P) (a : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => |I.weight 0 ω| ^ 3) P → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a n k ^ 2) Filter.atTop (nhds 1) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, |a n k| ^ 3) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → ∀ {ΩG : Type uΩG} [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace ΩG] {PG : MeasureTheory.Measure ΩG} [inst_3 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure PG] {Z : ΩG → ℝ}, ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw Z (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1) PG → MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution (I.weightedPreactivation a) Filter.atTop Z (fun x => P) PG
